document: Ulam UnsolvedMath ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra difficulty scores

records.name: P versus NP Problem
records.statement: Does $P = NP$? More formally: if the solution to a problem can be quickly verified (in polynomial time), can the solution also be quickly found (in polynomial time)?

records.name: The Riemann Hypothesis
records.statement: Do all non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function $\zeta(s)$ have real part equal to $\frac{1}{2}$?

records.name: Yang–Mills Existence and Mass Gap
records.statement: Prove that Yang–Mills theory exists and has a mass gap on $\mathbb{R}^4$, meaning the quantum particles have positive masses.

records.name: Navier–Stokes Existence and Smoothness
records.statement: Prove or give a counterexample: Do solutions to the Navier–Stokes equations in three dimensions always exist and remain smooth for all time?

records.name: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
records.statement: The conjecture relates the rank of the abelian group of rational points of an elliptic curve to the order of zero of the associated L-function at $s=1$.

records.name: Hodge Conjecture
records.statement: On a projective non-singular algebraic variety over $\mathbb{C}$, any Hodge class is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles.

records.name: Odd Perfect Numbers
records.statement: Does there exist an odd perfect number? A perfect number is a positive integer that is equal to the sum of its proper divisors (excluding itself). For example, $6 = 1 + 2 + 3$ is perfect.

records.name: Collatz Conjecture
records.statement: Starting with any positive integer $n$, repeatedly apply the function: if $n$ is even, divide by 2; if $n$ is odd, multiply by 3 and add 1. Does this process always eventually reach 1?

records.name: The Hadwiger-Nelson Problem
records.statement: What is the minimum number of colors needed to color the points of the plane such that no two points at distance 1 have the same color?

records.name: Twin Prime Conjecture
records.statement: Are there infinitely many twin primes? Twin primes are pairs of primes that differ by 2, such as (3, 5), (5, 7), (11, 13), (17, 19), (29, 31).

records.name: Goldbach's Conjecture
records.statement: Every even integer greater than 2 can be expressed as the sum of two primes.

records.name: ABC Conjecture
records.statement: For any $\epsilon > 0$, there exist only finitely many triples $(a, b, c)$ of coprime positive integers with $a + b = c$ such that $c > \text{rad}(abc)^{1+\epsilon}$, where $\text{rad}(n)$ is the product of distinct prime factors of $n$.

records.name: Hadwiger Conjecture
records.statement: Every graph with chromatic number $k$ has a $K_k$ minor (where $K_k$ is the complete graph on $k$ vertices).

records.name: Reconstruction Conjecture
records.statement: Every finite simple graph on at least 3 vertices is uniquely determined by its vertex-deleted subgraphs.

records.name: Smooth 4-Dimensional Poincaré Conjecture
records.statement: Is every smooth homotopy 4-sphere diffeomorphic to the standard 4-sphere $S^4$?

records.name: Sphere Packing in Higher Dimensions
records.statement: What is the densest packing of congruent spheres in $n$ dimensions for $n \geq 4$?

records.name: Inverse Galois Problem
records.statement: Is every finite group the Galois group of some Galois extension of the rational numbers $\mathbb{Q}$?

records.name: Kaplansky's Conjectures
records.statement: A set of conjectures about group rings: (1) Zero divisor conjecture: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $K$ is a field, then $K[G]$ has no zero divisors. (2) Idempotent conjecture: The only idempotents in $K[G]$ are 0 and 1. (3) Unit conjecture: The only units in $\mathbb{Z}[G]$ are of the form $\pm g$ for $g \in G$.

records.name: Continuum Hypothesis
records.statement: There is no set whose cardinality is strictly between that of the integers and the real numbers.

records.name: Legendre's Conjecture
records.statement: For every positive integer $n$, there exists a prime number between $n^2$ and $(n+1)^2$.

records.name: Are there infinitely many Mersenne primes?
records.statement: Are there infinitely many prime numbers of the form $M_p = 2^p - 1$ where $p$ is prime?

records.name: Are there infinitely many perfect powers in the Fibonacci sequence?
records.statement: Besides 1, 8, and 144, are there any other perfect powers (numbers of the form $a^b$ where $a, b > 1$) in the Fibonacci sequence?

records.name: Gilbreath's Conjecture
records.statement: Starting with the sequence of primes and repeatedly taking absolute differences of consecutive terms, the first term of each row is always 1.

records.name: Ramsey Number R(5,5)
records.statement: What is the exact value of $R(5,5)$, the smallest number $n$ such that any 2-coloring of the edges of $K_n$ contains a monochromatic $K_5$?

records.name: The Lonely Runner Conjecture
records.statement: For any $n$ runners on a circular track with distinct constant speeds, each runner is "lonely" (distance at least $1/n$ from all others) at some time.

records.name: The Graceful Tree Conjecture
records.statement: Every tree can be gracefully labeled: vertices can be assigned distinct labels from $\{0, 1, \ldots, |E|\}$ such that edge labels (absolute differences) are all distinct.

records.name: The Kakeya Conjecture
records.statement: A Kakeya set (containing a unit line segment in every direction) in $\mathbb{R}^n$ must have Hausdorff dimension $n$.

records.name: The Moving Sofa Problem
records.statement: What is the largest area of a shape that can be maneuvered through an L-shaped corridor of unit width?

records.name: The Volume Conjecture
records.statement: For a hyperbolic knot $K$, the limit of normalized colored Jones polynomials equals the hyperbolic volume of the knot complement.

records.name: The Standard Conjectures on Algebraic Cycles
records.statement: A collection of conjectures about algebraic cycles on smooth projective varieties, including Lefschetz standard conjecture and Künneth standard conjecture.

records.name: The Abundance Conjecture
records.statement: For a minimal model $X$ of non-negative Kodaira dimension, the canonical divisor $K_X$ is semi-ample.

records.name: The Köthe Conjecture
records.statement: A ring has no non-zero nil ideal (an ideal all of whose elements are nilpotent) if and only if it has no non-zero nil one-sided ideal.

records.name: The Regularity Problem for Euler Equations
records.statement: Do solutions to the 3D Euler equations for incompressible fluid flow remain smooth for all time, given smooth initial data?

records.name: Singular Cardinals Hypothesis
records.statement: If $\kappa$ is a singular strong limit cardinal, then $2^\kappa = \kappa^+$.

records.name: Whitehead Problem
records.statement: Is every abelian group $A$ such that $\text{Ext}^1(A, \mathbb{Z}) = 0$ a free abelian group?

records.name: The Unique Games Conjecture
records.statement: For certain constraint satisfaction problems (unique games), it is NP-hard to approximate the maximum fraction of satisfiable constraints beyond a certain threshold.

records.name: The Polynomial Hirsch Conjecture
records.statement: The diameter of the graph of a $d$-dimensional polytope with $n$ facets is bounded by a polynomial in $d$ and $n$.

records.name: Hilbert's 12th Problem: Extension of Kronecker-Weber Theorem
records.statement: Extend the Kronecker-Weber theorem on abelian extensions of the rationals to any base number field.

records.name: Hilbert's 16th Problem: Topology of Algebraic Curves and Limit Cycles
records.statement: Determine the maximum number and relative positions of limit cycles for polynomial vector fields of degree $n$, and investigate the topology of real algebraic curves and surfaces.

records.name: Landau's Fourth Problem: Primes of the Form n² + 1
records.statement: Are there infinitely many primes of the form $n^2 + 1$?

records.name: Smale's 4th Problem: Integer Zeros of Polynomials
records.statement: Find efficient algorithms for deciding whether a polynomial with integer coefficients has an integer root.

records.name: Smale's 5th Problem: Height Bounds for Diophantine Curves
records.statement: Find effective uniform bounds for the heights of rational points on algebraic curves.

records.name: Smale's 6th Problem: Finiteness of Central Configurations
records.statement: For the Newtonian $n$-body problem with positive masses, are there only finitely many central configurations (relative equilibria) for each $n$?

records.name: Smale's 7th Problem: Distribution of Points on the 2-Sphere
records.statement: What is the optimal arrangement of $n$ points on the 2-sphere to minimize energy for various potential functions?

records.name: Smale's 9th Problem: Linear Programming in Polynomial Time
records.statement: Find a strongly polynomial algorithm for linear programming.

records.name: Smale's 10th Problem: The Pugh Closing Lemma
records.statement: Is the $C^r$ closing lemma true for dynamical systems?

records.name: The Jacobian Conjecture
records.statement: If $F: \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}^n$ is a polynomial map with constant non-zero Jacobian determinant, then $F$ is invertible.

records.name: Frankl's Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
records.statement: For every finite union-closed family of sets (other than the empty family), there exists an element that belongs to at least half of the sets.

records.name: Inscribed Square Problem (Toeplitz Conjecture)
records.statement: Does every simple closed curve in the plane contain all four vertices of some square?

records.name: Brocard's Problem
records.statement: Find all integer solutions to $n! + 1 = m^2$.

records.name: The Cycle Double Cover Conjecture
records.statement: Every bridgeless graph has a cycle double cover: a collection of cycles that covers each edge exactly twice.

records.name: The Erdős-Straus Conjecture
records.statement: For every integer $n \geq 2$, the equation $\frac{4}{n} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} + \frac{1}{z}$ has a solution in positive integers x, y, z.

records.name: Hilbert's 6th Problem: Axiomatization of Physics
records.statement: Develop a mathematical framework that axiomatizes physics, particularly mechanics, thermodynamics, and probability theory.

records.name: Hilbert's 13th Problem: Seventh Degree Equations
records.statement: Prove that the general equation of the seventh degree cannot be solved using functions of only two variables.

records.name: Smale's 12th Problem: Centralizers of Diffeomorphisms
records.statement: Determine the structure of centralizers of generic diffeomorphisms.

records.name: The Dynamics of Networks
records.statement: Develop high-dimensional mathematics to model and predict behavior in large-scale distributed networks.

records.name: 21st Century Fluids
records.statement: Extend classical fluid dynamics to handle complex substances like foams, suspensions, gels, and liquid crystals.

records.name: Biological Quantum Field Theory
records.statement: Apply quantum and statistical field theory methods to model and potentially control pathogen evolution.

records.name: Beyond Convex Optimization
records.statement: Determine whether algebraic geometry can systematically replace linear algebra in optimization.

records.name: Mathematics of Quantum Computing
records.statement: Develop the mathematics required to control the quantum world for computation.

records.name: Game Theory at Scale
records.statement: Create scalable mathematics for differential games, replacing traditional PDE approaches.

records.name: Computation at Scale
records.statement: Develop asymptotics for systems with massive degrees of freedom.

records.name: Fundamental Laws of Biology
records.statement: Identify governing principles for biological systems, analogous to physical laws.

records.name: Computational Duality
records.statement: Use mathematical duality and geometry as foundations for developing novel computational algorithms.

records.name: Occam's Razor in Many Dimensions
records.statement: Find lower bounds for sensing complexity as data collection grows, addressing entropy maximization.

records.name: Physical Consequences of Perelman's Proof
records.statement: Apply Perelman's proof of the Poincaré conjecture to materials fabrication across scales.

records.name: Algorithmic Origami and Biology
records.statement: Strengthen mathematical theory for isometric and rigid embedding relevant to protein folding.

records.name: Optimal Nanostructures
records.statement: Develop mathematics for creating optimal symmetric structures through nanoscale self-assembly.

records.name: The Geometry of Genome Space
records.statement: Establish appropriate distance metrics on genome space incorporating biological utility.

records.name: Symmetries and Action Principles for Biology
records.statement: Extend understanding of symmetries and action principles in biology to include robustness, modularity, evolvability, and variability.

records.name: Geometric Langlands and Quantum Physics
records.statement: Connect the Langlands program to fundamental physics symmetries.

records.name: Arithmetic Langlands, Topology, and Geometry
records.statement: Explore homotopy theory's role in Langlands programs.

records.name: Hilbert's 7th Problem: Transcendence of Certain Numbers
records.statement: If $\alpha$ is algebraic and irrational, and $\beta$ is algebraic and irrational, is $\alpha^\beta$ transcendental?

records.name: Hilbert's 9th Problem: Reciprocity Laws
records.statement: Generalize the reciprocity law of number theory to arbitrary number fields.

records.name: Hilbert's 11th Problem: Quadratic Forms over Algebraic Number Fields
records.statement: Extend the theory of quadratic forms with algebraic numerical coefficients.

records.name: Hilbert's 14th Problem: Finite Generation of Rings
records.statement: Is the ring of invariants of a linear algebraic group acting on a polynomial ring always finitely generated?

records.name: Hilbert's 15th Problem: Schubert's Enumerative Calculus
records.statement: Rigorously justify Schubert's enumerative geometry.

records.name: Hilbert's 17th Problem: Expression of Definite Forms
records.statement: Can every non-negative rational function be expressed as a sum of squares of rational functions?

records.name: Hilbert's 18th Problem: Polyhedra and Space-Filling
records.statement: Are there only finitely many essentially different space-filling convex polyhedra? Is there a polyhedron which tiles space but not in a lattice arrangement?

records.name: Large Sum-Free Sets
records.statement: Let $A$ be a set of $n$ positive integers. Does $A$ contain a sum-free set of size at least $n/3 + \Omega(n)$, where $\Omega(n) \to \infty$ as $n \to \infty$?

records.name: Restricted Sumset Problem
records.statement: Let $A \subset \mathbb{Z}$ be a set of $n$ integers. Is there a subset $S \subset A$ of size $(\log n)^{100}$ such that $S \hat{+} S$ is disjoint from $A$?

records.name: Product-Free Sets in Finite Groups
records.statement: Which finite groups have the smallest largest product-free sets?

records.name: Ulam's Sequence
records.statement: Define Ulam's sequence $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 18, 26, 28, 36, \ldots$ where $u_1 = 1, u_2 = 2$, and $u_{n+1}$ is the smallest number uniquely expressible as $u_i + u_j$ for $i < j \leq n$. Does this sequence have positive density? Can one explain its curious Fourier properties?

records.name: Almost Sum-Free Sets
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset [N]$ has no more than $\varepsilon N^2$ solutions to $x + y = z$. Can one remove $\varepsilon' N$ elements to leave a sum-free set, where $\varepsilon' \to 0$ as $\varepsilon \to 0$, with a reasonable bound?

records.name: Sum-Free Subsets of [N]^d
records.statement: Fix an integer $d$. What is the largest sum-free subset of $[N]^d$?

records.name: Progressions in Subsets of Z/NZ
records.statement: Is $r_5(N) \ll N(\log N)^{-c}$? Is $r_4(\mathbb{F}_5^n) \ll N^{1-c}$ where $N = 5^n$?

records.name: Roth's Theorem with Random Common Differences
records.statement: Let $S \subset \mathbb{N}$ be random. Under what conditions is Roth's theorem for progressions of length 3 true with common differences in $S$?

records.name: Tuples in Dense Sets
records.statement: Let $G$ be an abelian group of size $N$, and suppose that $A \subset G$ has density $\alpha$. Are there at least $\alpha^{15}N^{10}$ tuples $(x_1, \ldots, x_5, y_1, \ldots, y_5) \in G^{10}$ such that $x_i + y_j \in A$ whenever $j \in \{i, i+1, i+2\}$?

records.name: 4-term APs in Fourier Uniform Sets
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ has density $\alpha$ and is Fourier uniform (all Fourier coefficients of $1_A - \alpha$ are $o(N)$). Does $A$ contain at least $\gg \alpha^{100}N^2$ 4-term arithmetic progressions?

records.name: Lipschitz AP-Free Graphs
records.statement: Does there exist a Lipschitz function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}$ whose graph $\Gamma = \{(n, f(n)) : n \in \mathbb{Z}\} \subset \mathbb{Z}^2$ is free of 3-term progressions?

records.name: Linear Equation x + 3y = 2z + 2w
records.statement: What is the largest subset of $[N]$ with no solution to $x + 3y = 2z + 2w$ in distinct integers $x, y, z, w$?

records.name: Progressions in F_3^n with Boolean Common Differences
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{F}_3^n$ is a set of density $\alpha$. Under what conditions on $\alpha$ is $A$ guaranteed to contain a 3-term progression with nonzero common difference in $\{0, 1\}^n$?

records.name: Corner Problem in Product Sets
records.statement: Suppose $G$ is a finite group, and let $A \subset G \times G$ be a subset of density $\alpha$. Are there $\gg_\alpha |G|^3$ triples $x, y, g$ such that $(x, y), (gx, y), (x, gy)$ all lie in $A$?

records.name: Multidimensional Szemerédi Theorem Bounds
records.statement: Find reasonable bounds for instances of the multidimensional Szemerédi theorem.

records.name: Large Sieve and Quadratic Sets
records.statement: Suppose that a large sieve process leaves a set of quadratic size. Is that set quadratic?

records.name: Small Sieve Maximal Sets
records.statement: Suppose that a small sieve process leaves a set of maximal size. What is the structure of that set?

records.name: Large Cosets in Iterated Sumsets
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$ has density $\alpha$. Does $10A$ contain a coset of some subspace of dimension at least $n - O(\log(1/\alpha))$?

records.name: Largest Coset in 2A
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$ has density $\alpha$. What is the largest size of coset guaranteed to be contained in $2A$?

records.name: Additive Complements and Cosets
records.statement: Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$ has an additive complement of size $K$. Does $2A$ contain a coset of codimension $O_K(1)$?

records.name: Partitions and Large Cosets
records.statement: Suppose that $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is partitioned into sets $A_1, \dots, A_K$. Does $2A_i$ contain a coset of codimension $O_K(1)$ for some $i$?

records.name: Gowers Box Norms over Finite Fields
records.statement: Let $p$ be an odd prime and suppose $f : \mathbb{F}_p^n \times \mathbb{F}_p^n \to \mathbb{C}$ is bounded pointwise by 1. Suppose $\mathbb{E}_h \|\Delta_{(h,h)}f\|_\square^4 \geq \delta$. Does $f$ correlate with a function of the form $a(x)b(y)c(x+y)(-1)^{q(x,y)}$?

records.name: Inverse Theorem for Gowers Norms
records.statement: Determine bounds for the inverse theorem for Gowers norms.

records.name: Φ(G) and Φ'(G) Coincidence
records.statement: Do $\Phi(G)$ and $\Phi'(G)$ coincide?

records.name: Sumsets Containing Composites
records.statement: Suppose $A, B \subset \{1, \dots, N\}$ both have size $N^{0.49}$. Does $A + B$ contain a composite number?

records.name: Sums of Smooth Numbers
records.statement: Is every $n \leq N$ the sum of two integers, all of whose prime factors are at most $N^\varepsilon$?

records.name: Sumsets of Perfect Squares
records.statement: Is there an absolute constant $c > 0$ such that if $A \subset \mathbb{N}$ is a set of squares of size at least 2, then $|A + A| \geq |A|^{1+c}$?

records.name: Covering Squares with Sumsets
records.statement: Suppose $A + A$ contains the first $n$ squares. Is $|A| \geq n^{1-o(1)}$?

records.name: Products of Primes Modulo p
records.statement: Let $p$ be a large prime, and let $A$ be the set of all primes less than $p$. Is every $x \in \{1, \dots, p-1\}$ congruent to some product $a_1a_2$ modulo $p$?

records.name: Multiplicatively Closed Set Density
records.statement: Let $A$ be the smallest set containing 2 and 3, and closed under the operation $a_1a_2 - 1$ (if $a_1, a_2 \in A$, then $a_1a_2 - 1 \in A$). Does $A$ have positive density?

records.name: Primes with p-2 Having Odd Omega
records.statement: Do there exist infinitely many primes $p$ for which $p-2$ has an odd number of prime factors (counting multiplicity)?

records.name: Difference Sets Containing Squares
records.statement: Is there $c > 0$ such that whenever $A \subset [N]$ has size $N^{1-c}$, the difference set $A - A$ contains a nonzero square?

records.name: Gaps Between Sums of Two Squares
records.statement: Is there always a sum of two squares between $X - \frac{1}{10}X^{1/4}$ and $X$?

records.name: Waring's Problem Over Finite Fields
records.statement: Determine bounds for Waring's problem over finite fields.

records.name: Cubic Curves in F_p^2
records.statement: Suppose $A \subset \mathbb{F}_p^2$ is a set meeting every line in at most 2 points. Is it true that all except $o(p)$ points of $A$ lie on a cubic curve?

records.name: Collinear Triples and Cubic Curves
records.statement: Fix $k$. Let $A \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a set of $n$ points with no more than $k$ on any line. Suppose at least $\delta n^2$ pairs $(x, y) \in A \times A$ have the line $xy$ containing a third point of $A$. Is there a cubic curve containing at least $cn$ points of $A$?

records.name: Erdős-Szekeres with Visibility
records.statement: Fix integers $k, \ell$. Given $n \geq n_0(k, \ell)$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$, is there either a line containing $k$ of them, or $\ell$ of them that are mutually visible?

records.name: Collinear 4-tuples Force Collinear 5-tuples
records.statement: Suppose $A \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ is a set of size $n$ with $cn^2$ collinear 4-tuples. Does it contain 5 points on a line?

records.name: No Three in Line in [N]^2
records.statement: What is the largest subset of the grid $[N]^2$ with no three points on a line? In particular, for $N$ sufficiently large, is it impossible to have a set of size $2N$ with this property?

records.name: Smooth Surfaces Intersecting 2-planes
records.statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a smooth codimension 2 surface in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Must $\Gamma$ intersect some 2-dimensional plane in 5 points, if $n$ is sufficiently large?

records.name: No 5 Points on 2-plane in [N]^d
records.statement: What is the largest subset of $[N]^d$ with no 5 points on a 2-plane?

records.name: Balanced Ham Sandwich Line
records.statement: Let $X \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a set of $n$ points. Does there exist a line $\ell$ through at least two points of $X$ such that the numbers of points on either side of $\ell$ differ by at most 100?

records.name: Sparse Hitting Set for Rectangles
records.statement: Let $A$ be a set of $n$ points in the plane. Can one select $A' \subset A$ of size $n/2$ such that any axis-parallel rectangle containing 1000 points of $A$ contains at least one point of $A'$?

records.name: Small Triangles in the Unit Disc
records.statement: Given $n$ points in the unit disc, must there be a triangle of area at most $n^{-2+o(1)}$ determined by them?

records.name: Axis-Parallel Rectangles in Dense Sets
records.statement: Suppose $A$ is an open subset of $[0, 1]^2$ with measure $\alpha$. Are there four points in $A$ determining an axis-parallel rectangle with area $\geq c\alpha^2$?

records.name: Equidistribution of Integer Multiples
records.statement: Let $c > 0$ and let $A$ be a set of $n$ distinct integers. Does there exist $\theta$ such that no interval of length $\frac{1}{n}$ in $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ contains more than $n^c$ of the numbers $\theta a \pmod 1$, for $a \in A$?

records.name: Random Permutations Fixing k-Sets
records.statement: Let $p(k)$ be the limit as $n \to \infty$ of the probability that a random permutation on $[n]$ preserves some set of size $k$. Is $p(k)$ a decreasing function of $k$? Is $p(k) = (C + o(1))k^{-\alpha}(\log k)^{-3/2}$ for some absolute constant $C$?

records.name: Comparable Elements in Integer Lattices
records.statement: Consider a set $S \subset [N]^3$ with the property that any two distinct elements $s, s'$ of $S$ are comparable (in the coordinatewise partial order). Is $|S| \leq N^{2-\delta}$ for some $\delta > 0$?

records.name: Stable Density on Subspaces
records.statement: Let $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$. If $V$ is a subspace, write $\alpha(V)$ for the density of $A$ on $V$. Is there some $V$ of moderately small codimension on which $\alpha$ is stable?

records.name: Almost Invariant Sets Under Affine Maps
records.statement: Suppose $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ has density $\frac{1}{2}$. Under what conditions on $K$ can $A$ be almost invariant under all maps $\phi(x) = ax + b$ with $|a|, |b| \leq K$?

records.name: Trace Reconstruction
records.statement: Given a string $x \in \{0, 1\}^n$, let $\tilde{x}$ be obtained by deleting bits independently at random with probability $\frac{1}{2}$. How many independent traces $\tilde{x}_1, \dots, \tilde{x}_m$ are needed to reconstruct $x$ with probability 0.9?

records.name: Irreducibility of Random {0,1} Polynomials
records.statement: Is a random polynomial with coefficients in $\{0, 1\}$ and nonzero constant term almost surely irreducible?

records.name: N Queens Problem Asymptotics
records.statement: In how many ways (asymptotically) $Q(n)$ may $n$ non-attacking queens be placed on an $n \times n$ chessboard?

records.name: Bounds for Birch's Theorem
records.statement: Let $d \geq 3$ be odd. Give bounds on $\nu(d)$ such that if $n > \nu(d)$ then any homogeneous polynomial $F(\mathbf{x}) \in \mathbb{Z}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ of degree $d$ has a nontrivial integer zero.

records.name: Solutions to Polynomial Equations in Dense Sets
records.statement: Finding a single solution to $F(x_1, \dots, x_n) = C$ can be very difficult. What conditions on $A$ ensure that the number of solutions in $A$ is roughly $\alpha^n$ times the number in $[X]$?

records.name: Residually Finite Groups
records.statement: Is every group well-approximated by finite groups?

records.name: Rado's Boundedness Conjecture
records.statement: Suppose $a_1, \dots, a_k$ are integers which do not satisfy Rado's condition. Is $c(a_1, \dots, a_k)$ bounded in terms of $k$ only?

records.name: Monochromatic x+y and xy
records.statement: If $\{1, \dots, N\}$ is $r$-coloured, then for $N \geq N_0(r)$ there exist integers $x, y \geq 3$ such that $x+y$ and $xy$ have the same colour. Find reasonable bounds for $N_0(r)$.

records.name: Affine Translates of {0,1,3}
records.statement: If $A$ is a set of $n$ integers, what is the maximum number of affine translates of the set $\{0, 1, 3\}$ that $A$ can contain?

records.name: Restricted Sumsets in Partitions
records.statement: For which values of $k$ is the following true: whenever we partition $[N] = A_1 \cup \dots \cup A_k$, we have $|\bigcup_{i=1}^k (A_i \hat{+} A_i)| \geq \frac{1}{10} N$?

records.name: Sum of Cubes in F_3^n
records.statement: Let $A_1, \dots, A_{100}$ be "cubes" in $\mathbb{F}_3^n$ (images of $\{0, 1\}^n$ under linear automorphisms). Is $A_1 + \dots + A_{100} = \mathbb{F}_3^n$?

records.name: Sets with No Unique Sum Representations
records.statement: What is the size of the smallest set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ (with at least two elements) for which no element in the sumset $A + A$ has a unique representation?

records.name: Uniform Random Variables with Uniform Sum
records.statement: Suppose $X, Y$ are finitely-supported independent random variables taking integer values such that $X + Y$ is uniformly distributed on its range. Are $X$ and $Y$ themselves uniformly distributed on their ranges?

records.name: Large Subsets of Approximate Groups
records.statement: Suppose $A$ is a $K$-approximate group (not necessarily abelian). Is there $S \subset A$ with $|S| \gg K^{-O(1)}|A|$ and $S^8 \subset A^4$?

records.name: Structured Subsets with Bounded Doubling
records.statement: Given a set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}$ with $D(A) \leq K$, find a large structured subset $A'$ which "obviously" has $D(A') \leq K + \varepsilon$.

records.name: Sidon Set Size Bounds
records.statement: Write $F(N)$ for the largest Sidon subset of $[N]$. Improve, at least for infinitely many $N$, the bounds $N^{1/2} + O(1) \leq F(N) \leq N^{1/2} + N^{1/4} + O(1)$.

records.name: Large Gaps in Dilates
records.statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ be a set of size $\sqrt{p}$. Is there a dilate of $A$ with a gap of length $100\sqrt{p}$?

records.name: Optimal Sidon Bases
records.statement: Are there infinitely many $q$ for which there is a set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| = (\sqrt{2} + o(1))q^{1/2}$ and $A + A = \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$?

records.name: Structure of Sets with Bounded Representation
records.statement: Suppose $A \subset [N]$ has size $\geq c\sqrt{N}$ and representation function $r_A(n) \leq r$ for all $n$. What can be said about the structure of $A$?

records.name: Disjoint Sumsets Construction
records.statement: For arbitrarily large $n$, does there exist an abelian group $H$ with $|H| = n^{2+o(1)}$ and subsets $A_1, \dots, A_n, B_1, \dots, B_n$ satisfying $|A_i||B_i| \geq n^{2-o(1)}$, $|A_i + B_i| = |A_i||B_i|$, such that $A_i + B_i$ are pairwise disjoint from $A_j + B_k$ ($j \neq k$)?

records.name: Cap Sets in F_7^n
records.statement: What is the largest subset $A \subset \mathbb{F}_7^n$ for which $A - A$ intersects $\{-1, 0, 1\}^n$ only at 0?

records.name: Covering by Random Translates
records.statement: If $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ is random with $|A| = \sqrt{p}$, can we almost surely cover $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $100\sqrt{p}$ translates of $A$?

records.name: Hamming Ball Covering Growth
records.statement: Let $r$ be fixed and let $H(r)$ be the Hamming ball of radius $r$ in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Let $f(r)$ be the smallest constant such that there exist infinitely many $n$ with subspaces $V_n \leq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ satisfying $V_n + H(r) = \mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $|V_n| = (f(r) + o(1)) \frac{2^n}{|H(r)|}$. Does $f(r) \to \infty$?

records.name: Pyjama Set Covering
records.statement: How many rotated (about the origin) copies of the "pyjama set" $\{(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}^2 : \operatorname{dist}(x, \mathbb{Z}) \leq \varepsilon\}$ are needed to cover $\mathbb{R}^2$?

records.name: Cohn-Elkies Scheme for Circle Packings
records.statement: Can the Cohn-Elkies scheme be used to prove the optimal bound for circle-packings?

records.name: Covering by Residue Classes
records.statement: Let $N$ be large. For each prime $p$ with $N^{0.51} \leq p < 2N^{0.51}$, pick a residue $a(p) \in \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. Is $\#\{n \in [N] : n \equiv a(p) \pmod p \text{ for some } p\} \gg N^{1-o(1)}$?

records.name: Sieving by Many Small Primes
records.statement: Sieve $[N]$ by removing half the residue classes mod $p_i$, for primes $2 \leq p_1 < p_2 < \dots < p_{1000} < N^{9/10}$. Does the remaining set have size at most $\frac{1}{10}N$?

records.name: Residue Class Multiple Coverage
records.statement: Can we pick residue classes $a_p \pmod p$, one for each prime $p \leq N$, such that every integer $\leq N$ lies in at least 10 of them?

records.name: Maximal Covering Interval
records.statement: What is the largest $y$ for which one may cover the interval $[y]$ by residue classes $a_p \pmod p$, one for each prime $p \leq x$?

records.name: Random Walk Mixing on Alternating Groups
records.statement: Pick $x_1, \dots, x_k \in A_n$ at random. Is it true that, almost surely as $n \to \infty$, the random walk on this set of generators and their inverses equidistributes in time $O(n \log n)$?

records.name: Bounds for Approximate Group Classification
records.statement: Find bounds in the classification theorem for approximate groups.

records.name: N-Queens Problem Asymptotics
records.statement: In how many ways (asymptotically) $Q(n)$ may $n$ non-attacking queens be placed on an $n \times n$ chessboard?

records.name: Bounds for Homogeneous Polynomial Zeros
records.statement: Let $d \geq 3$ be an odd integer. Give bounds on $\nu(d)$ such that if $n > \nu(d)$ the following is true: given any homogeneous polynomial $F(\mathbf{x}) \in \mathbb{Z}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ of degree $d$, there is some $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{Z}^n \setminus \{\mathbf{0}\}$ such that $F(\mathbf{x}) = 0$.

records.name: Polynomial Solutions in Dense Sets
records.statement: Finding a single solution to a polynomial equation $F(x_1, \dots, x_n) = C$ can be very difficult. What conditions on $A$ ensure that the number of such solutions in $A$ is roughly $\alpha^n$ times the number of solutions in $[X]$?

records.name: Sofic Groups
records.statement: Is every group well-approximated by finite groups?

records.name: Hadamard Conjecture
records.statement: For every positive integer $k$, does there exist a Hadamard matrix of order $4k$?

records.name: Köthe Conjecture
records.statement: If a ring has no nil ideal other than $\{0\}$, does it follow that it has no nil one-sided ideal other than $\{0\}$?

records.name: Connes Embedding Problem
records.statement: Can every finite von Neumann algebra be embedded into an ultrapower of the hyperfinite II₁ factor?

records.name: Jacobson's Conjecture
records.statement: For a left-and-right Noetherian ring $R$, is the intersection of all powers of the Jacobson radical $J(R)$ equal to zero?

records.name: Zauner's Conjecture
records.statement: Do SIC-POVMs (Symmetric Informationally Complete Positive Operator-Valued Measures) exist in all finite dimensions?

records.name: Casas-Alvero Conjecture
records.statement: If a univariate polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ over a field of characteristic 0 shares a common factor with each of its first $d-1$ derivatives, must $f$ be a power of a linear polynomial?

records.name: Andrews-Curtis Conjecture
records.statement: Can every balanced presentation of the trivial group be transformed into a trivial presentation by a sequence of Nielsen transformations and conjugations of relators?

records.name: Bounded Burnside Problem
records.statement: For which positive integers $m$ and $n$ is the free Burnside group $B(m,n)$ finite? In particular, is $B(2,5)$ finite?

records.name: Herzog-Schönheim Conjecture
records.statement: If a finite system of left cosets of subgroups of a group $G$ partitions $G$, then must at least two of the subgroups have the same index in $G$?

records.name: Existence of Perfect Cuboids
records.statement: Does there exist a rectangular cuboid where all edges, face diagonals, and space diagonals have integer lengths?

records.name: McKay Conjecture
records.statement: For a finite group $G$ and prime $p$, is the number of irreducible complex characters of $G$ whose degree is not divisible by $p$ equal to the corresponding number for the normalizer of a Sylow $p$-subgroup?

records.name: Are All Groups Surjunctive?
records.statement: Is every group surjunctive? That is, for any group $G$, if $\phi: A^G \to A^G$ is a cellular automaton that is injective, must it also be surjective?

records.name: Catalan-Mersenne Conjecture
records.statement: Are all Catalan-Mersenne numbers $C_n$ composite for $n > 4$? Here $C_0 = 2$ and $C_{n+1} = 2^{C_n} - 1$.

records.name: Are There Infinitely Many Mersenne Primes?
records.statement: Are there infinitely many prime numbers of the form $2^p - 1$ where $p$ is prime?

records.name: Sphere Packing Problem in Higher Dimensions
records.statement: What is the densest packing of spheres in dimensions 4 through 23? More generally, what is the optimal sphere packing density in dimension $n$?

records.name: Mahler's Conjecture
records.statement: Among all centrally symmetric convex bodies in $\mathbb{R}^n$, does the cube (or cross-polytope) minimize the product of the body's volume and the volume of its polar dual?

records.name: The Illumination Conjecture
records.statement: Can every convex body in $n$-dimensional space be illuminated by at most $2^n$ point light sources?

records.name: Kakeya Needle Problem
records.statement: What is the minimum area of a region in the plane in which a unit line segment can be continuously rotated through 360 degrees?

records.name: Bellman's Lost in a Forest Problem
records.statement: What is the shortest path that guarantees escape from a forest of known shape and size, starting from an unknown location?

records.name: The Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
records.statement: For any finite family of finite sets that is closed under taking unions, must there exist an element that belongs to at least half of the sets?

records.name: Singmaster's Conjecture
records.statement: Does there exist a finite upper bound on how many times a number (other than 1) can appear in Pascal's triangle?

records.name: The Continuum Hypothesis
records.statement: Is there a set whose cardinality is strictly between that of the integers and the real numbers?

records.name: Are There Infinitely Many Sophie Germain Primes?
records.statement: Are there infinitely many primes $p$ such that $2p + 1$ is also prime?

records.name: The Hodge Conjecture
records.statement: On a projective algebraic variety, is every Hodge class a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles?

records.name: The Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
records.statement: For an elliptic curve $E$ over the rationals, does the rank of its group of rational points equal the order of vanishing of its $L$-function at $s=1$?

records.name: The Weinstein Conjecture
records.statement: Does every Reeb vector field on a closed contact manifold have at least one periodic orbit?

records.name: The Painlevé Conjecture
records.statement: In the $n$-body problem with $n \geq 4$, can non-collision singularities occur in finite time?

records.name: Cereceda's Conjecture
records.statement: For any $k$-chromatic graph, can its $k$-colorings be transformed into each other by recoloring one vertex at a time, staying within $k$ colors, in polynomial time in the number of vertices?

records.name: The Whitehead Conjecture
records.statement: Is every aspherical closed manifold whose fundamental group has no non-trivial perfect normal subgroups a $K(\pi, 1)$ space?

records.name: The Knaster Problem
records.statement: Can a solid cube be completely covered by finitely many smaller homothetic cubes with ratio less than 1, such that the interiors are disjoint?

records.name: Polignac's Conjecture
records.statement: For every even number $n$, are there infinitely many pairs of consecutive primes differing by $n$?

records.name: The Babai Conjecture on Graph Isomorphism
records.statement: Can graph isomorphism be decided in quasi-polynomial time for all graphs?

records.name: Pillai's Conjecture
records.statement: For each positive integer $k$, does the equation $|2^m - 3^n| = k$ have only finitely many solutions in positive integers $m$ and $n$?

records.name: Erdős-Straus Conjecture
records.statement: For every integer $n \geq 2$, can $\frac{4}{n}$ be expressed as the sum of three unit fractions $\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} + \frac{1}{z}$?

records.name: The Gauss Circle Problem
records.statement: What is the optimal error term in the formula for the number of lattice points inside a circle of radius $r$?

records.name: Birch-Tate Conjecture
records.statement: Does the order of the center of the Steinberg group of the ring of integers of a number field relate to the value of the Dedekind zeta function at $s=-1$?

records.name: Hilbert's Fifteenth Problem
records.statement: Can Schubert calculus be given a rigorous foundation?

records.name: Hilbert's Sixteenth Problem
records.statement: What is the maximum number and relative positions of limit cycles for polynomial vector fields of degree $n$ in the plane?

records.name: The Inscribed Square Problem
records.statement: Does every simple closed curve in the plane contain four points that form the vertices of a square?

records.name: Falconer's Conjecture
records.statement: If a compact set in $\mathbb{R}^d$ has Hausdorff dimension greater than $d/2$, must it determine a set of distances with positive Lebesgue measure?

records.name: The Total Coloring Conjecture
records.statement: Can every graph be totally colored with at most $\Delta + 2$ colors, where $\Delta$ is the maximum degree?

records.name: The Odd Perfect Number Conjecture
records.statement: Do there exist any odd perfect numbers? (A perfect number equals the sum of its proper divisors.)

records.name: Firoozbakht's Conjecture
records.statement: Is the sequence $p_n^{1/n}$ strictly decreasing, where $p_n$ is the $n$-th prime?

records.name: The Tate Conjecture
records.statement: For varieties over finite fields, are the $\ell$-adic representations arising from étale cohomology related to algebraic cycles in the expected way?

records.name: Suslin's Problem
records.statement: If a dense linear order without endpoints is complete and has the countable chain condition, must it be isomorphic to the real numbers?

records.name: Schinzel's Hypothesis H
records.statement: If polynomials satisfy certain necessary divisibility conditions, do they simultaneously produce infinitely many primes for integer inputs?

records.name: The Uniform Boundedness Conjecture
records.statement: Is there a bound $B(g, d)$ such that every curve of genus $g$ over a number field of degree $d$ has at most $B(g, d)$ rational points?

records.name: The Pierce-Birkhoff Conjecture
records.statement: Is every piecewise-polynomial function $f: \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ the maximum of finitely many minimums of finite collections of polynomials?

records.name: Serre's Positivity Conjecture
records.statement: If $R$ is a regular local ring and $P, Q$ are prime ideals with intersecting dimensions satisfying a certain condition, is the intersection multiplicity positive?

records.name: Artin's Conjecture on Primitive Roots
records.statement: For how many prime numbers $p$ is a given integer $a$ (not $\pm 1$ or a perfect square) a primitive root modulo $p$?

records.name: The abc Conjecture
records.statement: For coprime integers $a, b, c$ with $a + b = c$, is $c$ usually not much larger than the product of distinct primes dividing $abc$?

records.name: The Shephard's Problem
records.statement: Can the unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^n$ be illuminated by fewer than $2^n$ directions?

records.name: The Andrews-Curtis Conjecture
records.statement: Can every balanced presentation of the trivial group be transformed into a trivial presentation by a sequence of Nielsen transformations and conjugations?

records.name: The Bounded Burnside Problem
records.statement: For which positive integers $m$ and $n$ is the free Burnside group $B(m,n)$ finite? In particular, is $B(2, 5)$ finite?

records.name: The Guralnick-Thompson Conjecture
records.statement: What are the composition factors of finite groups appearing in genus-0 systems?

records.name: The Herzog-Schönheim Conjecture
records.statement: If a finite system of left cosets of subgroups of a group $G$ partitions $G$, must some two subgroups have the same index?

records.name: The Inverse Galois Problem
records.statement: Is every finite group the Galois group of some Galois extension of $\mathbb{Q}$?

records.name: The Isomorphism Problem for Coxeter Groups
records.statement: Is there an algorithm to determine whether two Coxeter groups given by presentations are isomorphic?

records.name: Infinitude of Leinster Groups
records.statement: Are there infinitely many Leinster groups?

records.name: Existence of Generalized Moonshine
records.statement: Does generalized moonshine exist for all elements of the Monster group?

records.name: Finiteness of Finitely Presented Periodic Groups
records.statement: Is every finitely presented periodic group finite?

records.name: The Surjunctivity Conjecture
records.statement: Is every group surjunctive?

records.name: The Sofic Groups Conjecture
records.statement: Is every discrete countable group sofic?

records.name: Arthur's Conjectures
records.statement: What is the structure of the discrete spectrum of automorphic forms on reductive groups?

records.name: Dade's Conjecture
records.statement: Is there a relationship between the numbers of irreducible characters in blocks of a finite group and its local subgroups?

records.name: The Demazure Conjecture
records.statement: Can representations of semisimple algebraic groups be characterized over the integers?

records.name: The Spherical Bernstein Problem
records.statement: What is the classification of complete minimal hypersurfaces in spheres of all dimensions?

records.name: The Carathéodory Conjecture
records.statement: Does every convex, closed, twice-differentiable surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ have at least two umbilical points?

records.name: The Cartan-Hadamard Conjecture
records.statement: Does the isoperimetric inequality hold for Cartan-Hadamard manifolds?

records.name: Chern's Affine Conjecture
records.statement: Does the Euler characteristic of a compact affine manifold vanish?

records.name: Chern's Conjecture for Hypersurfaces in Spheres
records.statement: What minimal hypersurfaces in spheres have constant mean curvature?

records.name: The Closed Curve Problem
records.statement: What are necessary and sufficient conditions for an integral curve defined by two periodic functions to be closed?

records.name: The Filling Area Conjecture
records.statement: Does a hemisphere have minimum area among shortcut-free surfaces with a given boundary length?

records.name: The Hopf Conjectures
records.statement: What is the relationship between curvature and Euler characteristic for even-dimensional Riemannian manifolds?

records.name: The Osserman Conjecture
records.statement: Is every Osserman manifold either flat or locally isometric to a rank-one symmetric space?

records.name: Yau's Conjecture on First Eigenvalues
records.statement: Is the first eigenvalue of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on a minimal hypersurface in $S^{n+1}$ equal to $n$?

records.name: The Hadwiger Covering Conjecture
records.statement: Can every $n$-dimensional convex body be covered by at most $2^n$ smaller homothetic copies?

records.name: The Happy Ending Problem
records.statement: What is the minimum number of points in the plane needed to guarantee a convex $n$-gon?

records.name: The Heilbronn Triangle Problem
records.statement: What is the largest minimum area of a triangle determined by $n$ points in a unit square?

records.name: Kalai's $3^d$ Conjecture
records.statement: Does every centrally symmetric $d$-dimensional polytope have at least $3^d$ faces?

records.name: The Unit Distance Problem
records.statement: What is the maximum number of unit distances determined by $n$ points in the plane?

records.name: Ehrhart's Volume Conjecture
records.statement: Does a convex body in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with one interior lattice point at its center of mass have volume at most $(n+1)^n/n!$?

records.name: The Cherlin-Zilber Conjecture
records.statement: Is every simple group with a stable first-order theory an algebraic group over an algebraically closed field?

records.name: The Generalized Star Height Problem
records.statement: Can all regular languages be expressed with generalized regular expressions of bounded star height?

records.name: Hilbert's Tenth Problem for Number Fields
records.statement: For which number fields is there an algorithm to determine solvability of Diophantine equations?

records.name: Borsuk's Conjecture
records.statement: Can every bounded set in $\mathbb{R}^n$ be partitioned into $n+1$ sets of smaller diameter?

records.name: The Kissing Number Problem
records.statement: What is the maximum number of non-overlapping unit spheres that can touch a central unit sphere in $n$ dimensions?

records.name: Ulam's Packing Conjecture
records.statement: Is the sphere the worst-packing convex solid?

records.name: Sphere Packing in High Dimensions
records.statement: What is the densest packing of unit spheres in dimensions other than 1, 2, 3, 8, and 24?

records.name: The Cap Set Problem
records.statement: What is the maximum size of a cap set in $\mathbb{F}_3^n$?

records.name: The Sunflower Conjecture
records.statement: Does every family of at least $c^k k!$ sets of size $k$ contain a sunflower of size 3, for some absolute constant $c$?

records.name: Ramsey Number $R(5,5)$
records.statement: What is the exact value of the Ramsey number $R(5,5)$?

records.name: Gauss Circle Problem
records.statement: How far can the number of lattice points in a circle centered at the origin deviate from the area of the circle?

records.name: Grimm's Conjecture
records.statement: Can each element of a set of consecutive composite numbers be assigned a distinct prime divisor?

records.name: Hall's Conjecture
records.statement: For any $\varepsilon > 0$, is there a constant $c(\varepsilon)$ such that either $y^2 = x^3$ or $|y^2 - x^3| > c(\varepsilon) x^{1/2-\varepsilon}$?

records.name: Lehmer's Totient Problem
records.statement: If Euler's totient function $\phi(n)$ divides $n-1$, must $n$ be prime?

records.name: Magic Square of Squares
records.statement: Does there exist a 3×3 magic square composed entirely of distinct perfect squares?

records.name: Mahler's 3/2 Problem
records.statement: Is there a real number $x$ such that the fractional parts of $x(3/2)^n$ are all less than $1/2$ for every positive integer $n$?

records.name: Newman's Conjecture
records.statement: Does the partition function satisfy any arbitrary congruence infinitely often?

records.name: Scholz Conjecture
records.statement: Is the shortest addition chain for $2^n - 1$ at most $n - 1$ plus the length of the shortest addition chain for $n$?

records.name: Infinitely Many Perfect Numbers
records.statement: Are there infinitely many perfect numbers?

records.name: Quasiperfect Numbers
records.statement: Do quasiperfect numbers exist?

records.name: Almost Perfect Numbers Beyond Powers of 2
records.statement: Do any almost perfect numbers exist that are not powers of 2?

records.name: The Number of Idoneal Numbers
records.statement: Are there exactly 65 idoneal numbers, or could there be 66 or 67?

records.name: Amicable Numbers of Opposite Parity
records.statement: Do any pairs of amicable numbers exist where one is odd and one is even?

records.name: Infinitely Many Amicable Pairs
records.statement: Are there infinitely many pairs of amicable numbers?

records.name: Infinitely Many Giuga Numbers
records.statement: Are there infinitely many Giuga numbers?

records.name: Lychrel Numbers in Base 10
records.statement: Do Lychrel numbers exist in base 10?

records.name: Odd Weird Numbers
records.statement: Do any odd weird numbers exist?

records.name: Normality of Pi
records.statement: Is $\pi$ a normal number in base 10?

records.name: Normality of Irrational Algebraic Numbers
records.statement: Are all irrational algebraic numbers normal in every base?

records.name: Is 10 a Solitary Number?
records.statement: Is 10 a solitary number (no other number shares its abundancy index)?

records.name: Erdős Conjecture on Arithmetic Progressions
records.statement: If the sum of reciprocals of a set of positive integers diverges, does the set contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions?

records.name: Erdős-Turán Conjecture on Additive Bases
records.statement: If $B$ is an additive basis of order 2, must the representation function tend to infinity?

records.name: Lander-Parkin-Selfridge Conjecture
records.statement: If the sum of $m$ $k$-th powers equals the sum of $n$ $k$-th powers, must $m + n \geq k$?

records.name: Lemoine's Conjecture
records.statement: Can every odd integer greater than 5 be expressed as the sum of an odd prime and an even semiprime?

records.name: Recamán's Sequence Completeness
records.statement: Does every nonnegative integer appear in Recamán's sequence?

records.name: Skolem Problem
records.statement: Can an algorithm determine if a constant-recursive sequence contains a zero?

records.name: Waring's Problem: Exact Values
records.statement: What are the exact values of $g(k)$ and $G(k)$ for all $k$ in Waring's problem?

records.name: Density of Ulam Numbers
records.statement: Do the Ulam numbers have a positive density?

records.name: Class Number Problem
records.statement: Are there infinitely many real quadratic number fields with unique factorization?

records.name: Hilbert's Twelfth Problem
records.statement: Can the Kronecker-Weber theorem on abelian extensions of $\mathbb{Q}$ be extended to any base number field?

records.name: Leopoldt's Conjecture
records.statement: Does the $p$-adic regulator of an algebraic number field not vanish?

records.name: Lindelöf Hypothesis
records.statement: For all $\varepsilon > 0$, does $\zeta(1/2 + it) = o(t^\varepsilon)$ as $t \to \infty$?

records.name: Hilbert-Pólya Conjecture
records.statement: Do the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function correspond to eigenvalues of a self-adjoint operator?

records.name: Grand Riemann Hypothesis
records.statement: Do all automorphic L-functions have their nontrivial zeros on the critical line?

records.name: Montgomery's Pair Correlation Conjecture
records.statement: Does the pair correlation function of Riemann zeta zeros match that of random Hermitian matrices?

records.name: Dirichlet's Divisor Problem
records.statement: What is the optimal exponent in the error term for the divisor summatory function?

records.name: Erdős-Ulam Problem
records.statement: Is there a dense set of points in the plane with all pairwise distances rational?

records.name: Four Exponentials Conjecture
records.statement: If $x_1, x_2$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$ and $y_1, y_2$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$, is at least one of $e^{x_1 y_1}, e^{x_1 y_2}, e^{x_2 y_1}, e^{x_2 y_2}$ transcendental?

records.name: Irrationality of Euler's Constant
records.statement: Is the Euler-Mascheroni constant $\gamma$ irrational?

records.name: Transcendence of Apéry's Constant
records.statement: Is $\zeta(3) = 1 + 1/8 + 1/27 + 1/64 + \cdots$ transcendental?

records.name: Littlewood Conjecture
records.statement: For any two real numbers $\alpha, \beta$, does $\liminf_{n \to \infty} n \|n\alpha\| \|n\beta\| = 0$?

records.name: Integer Factorization in Polynomial Time
records.statement: Can integer factorization be solved in polynomial time on a classical computer?

records.name: Beal's Conjecture
records.statement: For $A^x + B^y = C^z$ with $x, y, z > 2$, must $A$, $B$, and $C$ share a common prime factor?

records.name: Fermat-Catalan Conjecture
records.statement: Are there finitely many solutions to $a^m + b^n = c^k$ with coprime $a,b,c$ and $1/m + 1/n + 1/k < 1$?

records.name: Bunyakovsky Conjecture
records.statement: Does an irreducible integer polynomial with no fixed prime divisor produce infinitely many primes?

records.name: Dickson's Conjecture
records.statement: Do finitely many linear forms simultaneously take prime values infinitely often, barring congruence obstructions?

records.name: Brocard's Conjecture (Prime Gaps)
records.statement: Are there always at least 4 primes between consecutive squares of primes $p_n^2$ and $p_{n+1}^2$?

records.name: Agoh-Giuga Conjecture
records.statement: Is $p$ prime if and only if $pB_{p-1} \equiv -1 \pmod{p}$ for the Bernoulli number $B_{p-1}$?

records.name: Elliott-Halberstam Conjecture
records.statement: Do primes distribute uniformly in arithmetic progressions up to nearly $x$ (instead of $x^{1/2}$)?

records.name: Birch–Tate Conjecture
records.statement: Is there a relation between the order of the center of the Steinberg group and the Dedekind zeta function?

records.name: Crouzeix's Conjecture
records.statement: Is $\|f(A)\| \leq 2\sup_{z \in W(A)} |f(z)|$ for all matrices $A$ and functions $f$ analytic on the numerical range?

records.name: Perfect Cuboid
records.statement: Does there exist a rectangular cuboid with integer edges, face diagonals, and space diagonal?

records.name: Zauner's Conjecture (SIC-POVM)
records.statement: Do symmetric informationally complete POVMs exist in all dimensions?

records.name: Andrews–Curtis Conjecture
records.statement: Can every balanced presentation of the trivial group be transformed to a trivial presentation by Nielsen moves?

records.name: Herzog–Schönheim Conjecture
records.statement: Can a finite system of left cosets forming a partition of a group have distinct indices?

records.name: Navier-Stokes Regularity
records.statement: Do smooth initial data for 3D Navier-Stokes equations yield smooth solutions for all time?

records.name: 1/3–2/3 Conjecture
records.statement: Does every non-totally-ordered finite poset have two elements with probability between 1/3 and 2/3 in random linear extensions?

records.name: Lonely Runner Conjecture

records.name: Hardy-Littlewood Conjecture F (Primes in Quadratic Polynomials)

Furthermore, the number $P(n)$ of primes of the form $f(x) \leq n$ satisfies an asymptotic formula $P(n) \sim A \cdot \frac{\sqrt{n}}{\log n}$ where $A$ depends on $a, b, c$ but not on $n$.

records.statement: Call prime $p_n$ good if $p_n^2 > p_{n-i}p_{n+i}$ for all $i$, $1 \le i \le n-1$. Is it true that the set of $n$ for which $p_n$ is good has density 0? Are there infinitely many $n$ with $p_n p_{n+1} > p_{n-i} p_{n+1+i}$ for all $i$, $1 \le i \le n-1$?

records.name: Congruent Products of Consecutive Numbers
records.statement: What is the least prime $p$ such that there are integers $a, k_1, k_2, k_3$ with $\prod_{i=1}^{k_1} (a+i) \equiv \prod_{i=1}^{k_2} (a+k_1+i) \equiv \prod_{i=1}^{k_3} (a+k_1+k_2+i) \equiv 1 \pmod{p}$?

records.name: Walking to Infinity on Gaussian Primes
records.statement: Can one walk from the origin to infinity using Gaussian primes as stepping stones and taking steps of bounded length?

records.name: Giuga's Conjecture on Prime Characterization
records.statement: Is it true that if $n$ divides $1^{n-1} + 2^{n-1} + \dots + (n-1)^{n-1} + 1$, then $n$ is prime?

records.name: Erdős-Selfridge Classification: Infinitely Many Primes in Each Class
records.statement: In the Erdős-Selfridge classification of primes, are there infinitely many primes in each class? Prime $p$ is in class 1 if the only prime divisors of $p+1$ are 2 or 3; and $p$ is in class $r$ if every prime factor of $p+1$ is in some class $\le r-1$, with equality for at least one prime factor.

records.name: Erdős Conjecture on $n - 2^k$ Prime
records.statement: Are 4, 7, 15, 21, 45, 75, and 105 the only values of $n$ for which $n - 2^k$ is prime for all $k$ such that $2 \le 2^k < n$?

records.name: Cohen-Selfridge Problem on $\pm p^a \pm 2^b$
records.statement: What is the least positive odd number not of the form $\pm p^a \pm 2^b$, where $p$ is an odd prime?

records.name: Density of Symmetric Primes
records.statement: Given pairs of odd primes $p, q$, define $S(q,p)$ as the number of lattice points $(m, n)$ in the rectangle $0 < m < p/2$, $0 < n < q/2$ below the diagonal. A pair is symmetric if $S(p, q) = S(q,p)$. Is the number of symmetric primes less than $x$ equal to $x/(\ln x)^{\sigma+o(1)}$, where $\sigma = 2 - (1+\ln \ln 2)/\ln 2 \approx 1.08607$?

records.name: Square Pseudoprimes
records.statement: Are there any square pseudoprimes (base 2) other than multiples of $1194649 = 1093^2$ or $12327121 = 3511^2$?

records.name: Selfridge-Wagstaff-Pomerance Prize Problem
records.statement: Does there exist a composite number $n \equiv 3$ or $7 \pmod{10}$ which divides both $2^n - 2$ and the Fibonacci number $u_{n+1}$?

records.name: Even Fibonacci Pseudoprimes
records.statement: Does there exist an even Fibonacci pseudoprime?

records.name: Erdős Problem #1
records.statement: If $A\subseteq \{1,\ldots,N\}$ with $\lvert A\rvert=n$ is such that the subset sums $\sum_{a\in S}a$ are distinct for all $S\subseteq A$ then $ N \gg 2^{n}. $

records.name: Erdős Problem #3
records.statement: If $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ has $\sum_{n\in A}\frac{1}{n}=\infty$ then must $A$ contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions?

records.name: Erdős Problem #5
records.statement: Let $C\geq 0$. Is there an infinite sequence of $n_i$ such that $ \lim_{i\to \infty}\frac{p_{n_i+1}-p_{n_i}}{\log n_i}=C? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #9
records.statement: Let $A$ be the set of all odd integers not of the form $p+2^{k}+2^l$ (where $k,l\geq 0$ and $p$ is prime). Is the upper density of $A$ positive?

records.name: Erdős Problem #10
records.statement: Is there some $k$ such that every integer is the sum of a prime and at most $k$ powers of 2?

records.name: Erdős Problem #12
records.statement: Let $A$ be an infinite set such that there are no distinct $a,b,c\in A$ such that $a\mid (b+c)$ and $b,c>a$. Is there such an $A$ with $ \liminf \frac{\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N^{1/2}}>0? $ Does there exist some absolute constant $c>0$ such that there are always infinitely many $N$ with $ \lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert<N^{1-c}? $ Is it true that $ \sum_{n\in A}\frac{1}{n}<\infty? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #14
records.statement:
Let $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$. Let $B\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be the set of integers which are representable in exactly one way as the sum of two elements from $A$.
Is it true that for all $\epsilon>0$ and large $N$ $ \lvert \{1,\ldots,N\}\backslash B\rvert \gg_\epsilon N^{1/2-\epsilon}? $ Is it possible that $ \lvert \{1,\ldots,N\}\backslash B\rvert =o(N^{1/2})? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #15
records.statement: Is it true that $ \sum_{n=1}^\infty(-1)^n\frac{n}{p_n} $ converges, where $p_n$ is the sequence of primes?

records.name: Erdős Problem #17
records.statement: Are there infinitely many primes $p$ such that every even number $n\leq p-3$ can be written as a difference of primes $n=q_1-q_2$ where $q_1,q_2\leq p$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #18
records.statement:
We call $m$ practical if every integer $n<m$ is the sum of distinct divisors of $m$. If $m$ is practical then let $h(m)$ be such that $h(m)$ many divisors always suffice.
Are there infinitely many practical $m$ such that $ h(m) < (\log\log m)^{O(1)}? $ Is it true that $h(n!)<n^{o(1)}$? Or perhaps even $h(n!)<(\log n)^{O(1)}$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #20
records.statement: Let $f(n,k)$ be minimal such that every family $\mathcal{F}$ of $n$-uniform sets with $\lvert \mathcal{F}\rvert \geq f(n,k)$ contains a $k$-sunflower. Is it true that $ f(n,k) < c_k^n $ for some constant $c_k>0$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #25
records.statement:
Let $n_1<n_2<\cdots$ be an arbitrary sequence of integers, each with an associated residue class $a_i\pmod{n_i}$. Let $A$ be the set of integers $n$ such that for every $i$ either $n<n_i$ or $n
ot\equiv a_i\pmod{n_i}$. Must the logarithmic density of $A$ exist?

records.name: Erdős Problem #28
records.statement: If $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ is such that $A+A$ contains all but finitely many integers then $\limsup 1_A\ast 1_A(n)=\infty$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #30
records.statement: Let $h(N)$ be the maximum size of a Sidon set in $\{1,\ldots,N\}$. Is it true that, for every $\epsilon>0$, $ h(N) = N^{1/2}+O_\epsilon(N^\epsilon)? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #32
records.statement:
Is there a set $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ such that $ \lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert = o((\log N)^2) $ and such that every large integer can be written as $p+a$ for some prime $p$ and $a\in A$?
Can the bound $O(\log N)$ be achieved? Must such an $A$ satisfy $ \liminf \frac{\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{\log N}> 1? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #33
records.statement: Let $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ be such that every large integer can be written as $n^2+a$ for some $a\in A$ and $n\geq 0$. What is the smallest possible value of $ \limsup \frac{\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N^{1/2}}? $ Is $ \liminf \frac{\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N^{1/2}}>1? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #36
records.statement:
Find the optimal constant $c>0$ such that the following holds.
For all sufficiently large $N$, if $A\sqcup B=\{1,\ldots,2N\}$ is a partition into two equal parts, so that $\lvert A\rvert=\lvert B\rvert=N$, then there is some $x$ such that the number of solutions to $a-b=x$ with $a\in A$ and $b\in B$ is at least $cN$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #38
records.statement:
Does there exist $B\subset\mathbb{N}$ which is not an additive basis, but is such that for every set $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ of Schnirelmann density $\alpha$ and every $N$ there exists $b\in B$ such that $ \lvert (A\cup (A+b))\cap \{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert\geq (\alpha+f(\alpha))N $ where $f(\alpha)>0$ for $0<\alpha <1 $?
The Schnirelmann density is defined by $ d_s(A) = \inf_{N\geq 1}\frac{\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N}. $

records.name: Erdős Problem #39
records.statement: Is there an infinite Sidon set $A\subset \mathbb{N}$ such that $ \lvert A\cap \{1\ldots,N\}\rvert \gg_\epsilon N^{1/2-\epsilon} $ for all $\epsilon>0$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #40
records.statement: For what functions $g(N)\to \infty$ is it true that $ \lvert A\cap \{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert \gg \frac{N^{1/2}}{g(N)} $ implies $\limsup 1_A\ast 1_A(n)=\infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #41
records.statement: Let $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ be an infinite set such that the triple sums $a+b+c$ are all distinct for $a,b,c\in A$ (aside from the trivial coincidences). Is it true that $ \liminf \frac{\lvert A\cap \{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N^{1/3}}=0? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #42
records.statement: Let $M\geq 1$ and $N$ be sufficiently large in terms of $M$. Is it true that for every Sidon set $A\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ there is another Sidon set $B\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ of size $M$ such that $(A-A)\cap(B-B)=\{0\}$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #43
records.statement: If $A,B\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ are two Sidon sets such that $(A-A)\cap(B-B)=\{0\}$ then is it true that $  \binom{\lvert A\rvert}{2}+\binom{\lvert B\rvert}{2}\leq\binom{f(N)}{2}+O(1), $ where $f(N)$ is the maximum possible size of a Sidon set in $\{1,\ldots,N\}$? If $\lvert A\rvert=\lvert B\rvert$ then can this bound be improved to $ \binom{\lvert A\rvert}{2}+\binom{\lvert B\rvert}{2}\leq (1-c+o(1))\binom{f(N)}{2} $ for some constant $c>0$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #44
records.statement: Let $N\geq 1$ and $A\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ be a Sidon set. Is it true that, for any $\epsilon>0$, there exist $M$ and $B\subset \{N+1,\ldots,M\}$ (which may depend on $N,A,\epsilon$) such that $A\cup B\subset \{1,\ldots,M\}$ is a Sidon set of size at least $(1-\epsilon)M^{1/2}$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #50
records.statement: Schoenberg proved that for every $c\in [0,1]$ the density of $ \{ n\in \mathbb{N} : \phi(n)<cn\} $ exists. Let this density be denoted by $f(c)$. Is it true that there are no $x$ such that $f'(x)$ exists and is positive?

records.name: Erdős Problem #51
records.statement: Is there an infinite set $A\subset \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $a\in A$ there is an integer $n$ such that $\phi(n)=a$, and yet if $n_a$ is the smallest such integer then $n_a/a\to \infty$ as $a\to\infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #52
records.statement: Let $A$ be a finite set of integers. Is it true that for every $\epsilon>0$ $ \max( \lvert A+A\rvert,\lvert AA\rvert)\gg_\epsilon \lvert A\rvert^{2-\epsilon}? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #60
records.statement: Does every graph on $n$ vertices with $>\mathrm{ex}(n;C_4)$ edges contain $\gg n^{1/2}$ many copies of $C_4$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #61
records.statement: For any graph $H$ is there some $c=c(H)>0$ such that every graph $G$ on $n$ vertices that does not contain $H$ as an induced subgraph contains either a complete graph or independent set on $\geq n^c$ vertices?

records.name: Erdős Problem #62
records.statement: If $G_1,G_2$ are two graphs with chromatic number $\aleph_1$ then must there exist a graph $G$ whose chromatic number is $4$ (or even $\aleph_0$) which is a subgraph of both $G_1$ and $G_2$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #65
records.statement: Let $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices and $kn$ edges, and $a_1<a_2<\cdots $ be the lengths of cycles in $G$. Is it true that $ \sum\frac{1}{a_i}\gg \log k? $ Is the sum $\sum\frac{1}{a_i}$ minimised when $G$ is a complete bipartite graph?

records.name: Erdős Problem #66
records.statement:
Is there $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ such that $ \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1_A\ast 1_A(n)}{\log n} $ exists and is $
eq 0$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #68
records.statement: Is $ \sum_{n\geq 2}\frac{1}{n!-1} $ irrational?

records.name: Erdős Problem #70
records.statement: Let $\mathfrak{c}$ be the ordinal of the real numbers, $\beta$ be any countable ordinal, and $2\leq n<\omega$. Is it true that $\mathfrak{c}\to (\beta, n)_2^3$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #74
records.statement: Let $f(n)\to \infty$ (possibly very slowly). Is there a graph of infinite chromatic number such that every finite subgraph on $n$ vertices can be made bipartite by deleting at most $f(n)$ edges?

records.name: Erdős Problem #75
records.statement: Is there a graph of chromatic number $\aleph_1$ such that for all $\epsilon>0$ if $n$ is sufficiently large and $H$ is a subgraph on $n$ vertices then $H$ contains an independent set of size $>n^{1-\epsilon}$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #77
records.statement: If $R(k)$ is the Ramsey number for $K_k$, the minimal $n$ such that every $2$-colouring of the edges of $K_n$ contains a monochromatic copy of $K_k$, then find the value of $ \lim_{k\to \infty}R(k)^{1/k}. $

records.name: Erdős Problem #78
records.statement: Give a constructive proof that $R(k)>C^k$ for some constant $C>1$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #80
records.statement:
Let $c>0$ and let $f_c(n)$ be the maximal $m$ such that every graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and at least $cn^2$ edges, where each edge is contained in at least one triangle, must contain a book of size $m$, that is, an edge shared by at least $m$ different triangles.
Estimate $f_c(n)$. In particular, is it true that $f_c(n)>n^{\epsilon}$ for some $\epsilon>0$? Or $f_c(n)\gg \log n$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #81
records.statement: Let $G$ be a chordal graph on $n$ vertices - that is, $G$ has no induced cycles of length greater than $3$. Can the edges of $G$ be partitioned into $n^2/6+O(n)$ many cliques?

records.name: Erdős Problem #82
records.statement: Let $F(n)$ be maximal such that every graph on $n$ vertices contains a regular induced subgraph on at least $F(n)$ vertices. Prove that $F(n)/\log n\to \infty$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #84
records.statement:
The cycle set of a graph $G$ on $n$ vertices is a set $A\subseteq \{3,\ldots,n\}$ such that there is a cycle in $G$ of length $\ell$ if and only if $\ell \in A$. Let $f(n)$ count the number of possible such $A$.
Prove that $f(n)=o(2^n)$.
Prove that $f(n)/2^{n/2}\to \infty$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #86
records.statement: Let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube graph (so that $Q_n$ has $2^n$ vertices and $n2^{n-1}$ edges). Is it true that every subgraph of $Q_n$ with $ \geq \left(\frac{1}{2}+o(1)\right)n2^{n-1} $ many edges contains a $C_4$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #87
records.statement:
Let $\epsilon >0$. Is it true that, if $k$ is sufficiently large, then $ R(G)>(1-\epsilon)^kR(k) $ for every graph $G$ with chromatic number $\chi(G)=k$?
Even stronger, is there some $c>0$ such that, for all large $k$, $R(G)>cR(k)$ for every graph $G$ with chromatic number $\chi(G)=k$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #89
records.statement: Does every set of $n$ distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ determine $\gg n/\sqrt{\log n}$ many distinct distances?

records.name: Erdős Problem #90
records.statement: Does every set of $n$ distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ contain at most $n^{1+O(1/\log\log n)}$ many pairs which are distance 1 apart?

records.name: Erdős Problem #91
records.statement: Let $n$ be a sufficently large integer. Suppose $A\subset \mathbb{R}^2$ has $\lvert A\rvert=n$ and minimises the number of distinct distances between points in $A$. Prove that there are at least two (and probably many) such $A$ which are non-similar.

records.name: Erdős Problem #92
records.statement:
Let $f(n)$ be maximal such that there exists a set $A$ of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ in which every $x\in A$ has at least $f(n)$ points in $A$ equidistant from $x$.
Is it true that $f(n)\leq n^{o(1)}$? Or even $f(n) < n^{O(1/\log\log n)}$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #96
records.statement: If $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ form a convex polygon then there are $O(n)$ many pairs which are distance $1$ apart.

records.name: Erdős Problem #98
records.statement: Let $h(n)$ be such that any $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$, with no three on a line and no four on a circle, determine at least $h(n)$ distinct distances. Does $h(n)/n\to \infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #99
records.statement: Let $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}^2$ be a set of $n$ points with minimum distance equal to 1, chosen to minimise the diameter of $A$. If $n$ is sufficiently large then must there be three points in $A$ which form an equilateral triangle of size 1?

records.name: Erdős Problem #100
records.statement: Let $A$ be a set of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ such that all pairwise distances are at least $1$ and if two distinct distances differ then they differ by at least $1$. Is the diameter of $A$ $\gg n$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #101
records.statement: Given $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$, no five of which are on a line, the number of lines containing four points is $o(n^2)$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #102
records.statement: Let $c>0$ and $h_c(n)$ be such that for any $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ such that there are $\geq cn^2$ lines each containing more than three points, there must be some line containing $h_c(n)$ many points. Estimate $h_c(n)$. Is it true that, for fixed $c>0$, we have $h_c(n)\to \infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #103
records.statement:
Let $h(n)$ count the number of incongruent sets of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ which minimise the diameter subject to the constraint that $d(x,y)\geq 1$ for all points $x
eq y$. Is it true that $h(n)\to \infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #104
records.statement: Given $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ the number of distinct unit circles containing at least three points is $o(n^2)$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #108
records.statement: For every $r\geq 4$ and $k\geq 2$ is there some finite $f(k,r)$ such that every graph of chromatic number $\geq f(k,r)$ contains a subgraph of girth $\geq r$ and chromatic number $\geq k$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #111
records.statement:
If $G$ is a graph let $h_G(n)$ be defined such that any subgraph of $G$ on $n$ vertices can be made bipartite after deleting at most $h_G(n)$ edges.
What is the behaviour of $h_G(n)$? Is it true that $h_G(n)/n\to \infty$ for every graph $G$ with chromatic number $\aleph_1$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #112
records.statement: Let $k=k(n,m)$ be minimal such that any directed graph on $k$ vertices must contain either an independent set of size $n$ or a transitive tournament of size $m$. Determine $k(n,m)$.

records.name: Erdős Problem #114
records.statement: If $p(z)\in\mathbb{C}[z]$ is a monic polynomial of degree $n$ then is the length of the curve $\{ z\in \mathbb{C} : \lvert p(z)\rvert=1\}$ maximised when $p(z)=z^n-1$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #117
records.statement:
Let $h(n)$ be minimal such that any group $G$ with the property that any subset of $>n$ elements contains some $x
eq y$ such that $xy=yx$ can be covered by at most $h(n)$ many Abelian subgroups.
Estimate $h(n)$ as well as possible.

records.name: Erdős Problem #119
records.statement:
Let $z_i$ be an infinite sequence of complex numbers such that $\lvert z_i\rvert=1$ for all $i\geq 1$, and for $n\geq 1$ let $ p_n(z)=\prod_{i\leq n} (z-z_i). $ Let $M_n=\max_{\lvert z\rvert=1}\lvert p_n(z)\rvert$.
Is it true that $\limsup M_n=\infty$?
Is it true that there exists $c>0$ such that for infinitely many $n$ we have $M_n > n^c$?
Is it true that there exists $c>0$ such that, for all large $n$, $ \sum_{k\leq n}M_k > n^{1+c}? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #120
records.statement:
Let $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ be an infinite set. Must there be a set $E\subset \mathbb{R}$ of positive measure which does not contain any set of the shape $aA+b$ for some $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$ and $a
eq 0$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #122
records.statement: For which number theoretic functions $f$ is it true that, for any $F(n)$ such that $f(n)/F(n)\to 0$ for almost all $n$, there are infinitely many $x$ such that $ \frac{\#\{ n\in \mathbb{N} : n+f(n)\in (x,x+F(x))\}}{F(x)}\to \infty? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #123
records.statement: Let $a,b,c\geq 1$ be three integers which are pairwise coprime. Is every large integer the sum of distinct integers of the form $a^kb^lc^m$ ($k,l,m\geq 0$), none of which divide any other?

records.name: Erdős Problem #124
records.statement:
For any $d\geq 1$ and $k\geq 0$ let $P(d,k)$ be the set of integers which are the sum of distinct powers $d^i$ with $i\geq k$. Let $3\leq d_1<d_2<\cdots <d_r$ be integers such that $ \sum_{1\leq i\leq r}\frac{1}{d_r-1}\geq 1. $ Can all sufficiently large integers be written as a sum of the shape $\sum_i c_ia_i$ where $c_i\in \{0,1\}$ and $a_i\in P(d_i,0)$?
If we further have $\mathrm{gcd}(d_1,\ldots,d_r)=1$ then, for any $k\geq 1$, can all sufficiently large integers be written as a sum of the shape $\sum_i c_ia_i$ where $c_i\in \{0,1\}$ and $a_i\in P(d_i,k)$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #125
records.statement:
Let $A = \{ \sum\epsilon_k3^k : \epsilon_k\in \{0,1\}\}$ be the set of integers which have only the digits $0,1$ when written base $3$, and $B=\{ \sum\epsilon_k4^k : \epsilon_k\in \{0,1\}\}$ be the set of integers which have only the digits $0,1$ when written base $4$.
Does $A+B$ have positive density?

records.name: Erdős Problem #126
records.statement:
Let $f(n)$ be maximal such that if $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ has $\lvert A\rvert=n$ then $\prod_{a
eq b\in A}(a+b)$ has at least $f(n)$ distinct prime factors. Is it true that $f(n)/\log n\to\infty$?

records.name: Erdős Problem #129
records.statement: Let $R(n;k,r)$ be the smallest $N$ such that if the edges of $K_N$ are $r$-coloured then there is a set of $n$ vertices which does not contain a copy of $K_k$ in at least one of the $r$ colours. Prove that there is a constant $C=C(r)>1$ such that $ R(n;3,r) < C^{\sqrt{n}}. $

records.name: Erdős Problem #130
records.statement:
Let $A\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ be an infinite set which contains no three points on a line and no four points on a circle. Consider the graph with vertices the points in $A$, where two vertices are joined by an edge if and only if they are an integer distance apart.
How large can the chromatic number and clique number of this graph be? In particular, can the chromatic number be infinite?

records.name: Erdős Problem #131
records.statement: Let $F(N)$ be the maximal size of $A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}$ such that no $a\in A$ divides the sum of any distinct elements of $A\backslash\{a\}$. Estimate $F(N)$. In particular, is it true that $ F(N) > N^{1/2-o(1)}? $

records.name: Erdős Problem #132
