records.name: Rigorous Diffraction from Two Slits
records.statement: Give a rigorous explicit solution of the fixed-frequency scalar-wave diffraction problem for two finite slits in the plane, including asymptotics of the solution.

records.name: Mutually Unbiased Bases in Dimension Six
records.statement: Construct a set of at least four mutually unbiased bases in dimension six, or prove that there are no seven mutually unbiased bases in $\mathcal{H}_6$.

records.name: Bound Entanglement with Negative Partial Transpose
records.statement: Determine whether there exist bound entangled bipartite quantum states with negative partial transpose.

records.name: O3 — Finding a prime above a bound
records.statement: Given $n\in\mathbb{N}$, can a prime $p>n$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O4 — Finding a prime in an arithmetic progression
records.statement: Given coprime $a,n\in\mathbb{N}$, can a prime $p\equiv a\pmod n$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O5a — Deterministic polynomial-time integer factorization
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization $C_5$ in deterministic polynomial time $P$?

records.name: O5b — Randomized polynomial-time integer factorization
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization $C_5$ in randomized polynomial time $R$?

records.name: O6 — Factoring a positive-density set of integers
records.statement: Does there exist a set $S\subset\mathbb{N}$ of positive lower asymptotic density for which complete factorization of every input $n\in S$ is in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O7a — Computing the squarefree part
records.statement: Given $n$, can one find $r,s\in\mathbb{N}$ with $n=r^2s$ and $s$ squarefree in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O7b — Factoring from a squarefree-part oracle
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization randomized polynomial-time reducible to computation of the squarefree part?

records.name: O8 — Deterministic polynomial-time squarefreeness testing
records.statement: Can one decide in deterministic polynomial time whether an integer $n$ is squarefree?

records.name: O9 — Counting distinct prime factors
records.statement: Can $\omega(n)$, the number of distinct prime factors of $n$, be computed in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O10 — Factoring from roots modulo a composite
records.statement: Let $C_{10}$ find $x$ satisfying $x^e\equiv a\pmod n$ under $\gcd(e,\varphi(n))=\gcd(a,n)=1$. Is complete integer factorization randomized polynomial-time reducible to $C_{10}$?

records.name: O11a — Quadratic residuosity modulo a composite
records.statement: Can one decide in deterministic polynomial time whether a coprime integer $a$ is a square modulo a composite $n$?

records.name: O11b — Factoring from composite quadratic residuosity
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization randomized polynomial-time reducible to deciding quadratic residuosity modulo a composite?

records.name: O12 — Finding a quadratic nonresidue
records.statement: Given a prime $p$, can a quadratic nonresidue modulo $p$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O13 — Realizing a prescribed quadratic signature
records.statement: Given a sign vector $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}^k$, can the least prime $p$ satisfying $(p_i/p)=\varepsilon_i$ for every $i\le k$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O14 — Square roots modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and a quadratic residue $a$, can a square root $x^2\equiv a\pmod p$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O15 — Polynomial roots modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and $f\in(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})[x]$ known to have a root, can a root be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O16 — Factoring polynomials modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and $f\in(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})[x]$, can the complete irreducible factorization of $f$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O17 — Constructing irreducible polynomials over finite fields
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and degree $d$, can an irreducible polynomial of degree $d$ over $\mathbb{F}_p$ be constructed in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O18a — Recognizing primitive roots deterministically
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and $b$, can one decide in deterministic polynomial time whether $b$ generates $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$?

records.name: O18b — Recognizing primitive roots randomly
records.statement: Is recognition of primitive roots modulo a prime in randomized polynomial time $R$?

records.name: O19 — Finding a primitive root modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$, can a generator of $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O20 — Computing multiplicative orders modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and $a$ coprime to $p$, can $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ be computed in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O21 — Discrete logarithms modulo a prime
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and elements $g,b$ with $b$ in the subgroup generated by $g$, can an exponent $x$ satisfying $g^x\equiv b\pmod p$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O22a — Discrete logarithms modulo a composite
records.statement: Given $g,b,n$ such that $g^x\equiv b\pmod n$ has a solution, can such an exponent $x$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O22b — Factoring from composite discrete logarithms
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization deterministically polynomial-time reducible to discrete logarithms modulo composites?

records.name: O23 — Factoring from Euler's totient
records.statement: Is complete integer factorization deterministically polynomial-time reducible to computing $\varphi(n)$?

records.name: O24 — Finding a point on an elliptic curve
records.statement: Given $a,b$ and a prime $p$ with nonsingular curve $y^2=x^3+ax+b$, can a point on the curve modulo $p$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O25 — Solving binary quadratic congruences
records.statement: Given $k,m,n$ with odd $n$ and $\gcd(km,n)=1$, can integers $x,y$ satisfying $x^2-ky^2\equiv m\pmod n$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O26 — Discrete logarithm versus Diffie–Hellman key distribution
records.statement: Is discrete logarithm modulo a prime randomized polynomial-time reducible to computing $g^{xy}$ from $g,g^x,g^y$?

records.name: O27 — Elliptic curves of prescribed order
records.statement: Given a prime $p$ and $n$, can one construct in deterministic polynomial time an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{F}_p$ having exactly $n$ points whenever one exists?

records.name: O28 — Discrete logarithms in elliptic-curve groups
records.statement: Given an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{F}_p$ and points $P,Q$ such that $P=nQ$ for some $n$, can such an $n$ be found in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O29 — NP-hardness of exact shortest vector
records.statement: For a full-rank integer lattice, is finding a nonzero vector of minimum Euclidean norm NP-hard?

records.name: O30 — Polynomial-factor lattice approximation
records.statement: Does there exist a constant $c$ for which one can find in deterministic polynomial time a nonzero lattice vector of length at most $n^c$ times the minimum?

records.name: O31 — Order of a polynomial's Galois group
records.statement: Given $f\in\mathbb{Q}[x]$, can the degree of its splitting field, equivalently the order of its Galois group, be computed in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O32 — Class numbers of imaginary quadratic orders
records.statement: Given $d\in\mathbb{N}$, can the class number $h(-d)$ of binary quadratic forms of discriminant $-d$ be computed in deterministic polynomial time?

records.name: O33a — NP-hardness of binary quadratic Diophantine solvability
records.statement: Under the promise that $b^2-4ac$ is not a square, is deciding whether $ax^2+bxy+cy^2+dx+ey+f=0$ has an integral solution NP-hard?

records.name: O33b — Randomized NP-hardness of binary quadratic Diophantine solvability
records.statement: Is the same binary quadratic Diophantine solvability problem NP-hard under randomized reductions?

records.name: O34 — Solvability of the negative Pell equation
records.statement: Can one decide in deterministic polynomial time whether $x^2-dy^2=-1$ has an integral solution?

records.name: O35 — Greatest common divisors in NC
records.statement: Can $\gcd(a,b)$ be computed in the parallel complexity class $NC$?

records.name: O36 — Integer multiplication in linear bit complexity
records.statement: Can two positive integers $a,b$ be multiplied using $O(\log(ab))$ bit operations?

records.name: Absolute bounds for rational Diophantine tuples
records.statement: Is there an absolute upper bound for the size of a rational Diophantine $m$-tuple, a set of nonzero rationals for which the product of every two distinct elements plus $1$ is a rational square?

records.name: Exceptional parameters without D(n)-quadruples
records.statement: For each $n\in\{-3,3,5,8,12,20\}$, prove that no set of four distinct positive integers has property $D(n)$, meaning that every pairwise product plus $n$ is a square. (The page's original exceptional set also contained $-1$ and $-4$, which subsequent results on the same page settle.)

records.name: Finiteness of parameters admitting at most two D(n)-quadruples
records.statement: Let $U$ be the set of integers $n\not\equiv2\pmod4$ for which there are at most two distinct $D(n)$-quadruples. Is $U$ finite?

records.name: Finiteness of D(n)-quadruples for nonsquare n
records.statement: For every nonzero integer $n$ that is not a square, are there only finitely many $D(n)$-quadruples?

records.name: Extremal parameters for D(n)-quintuples
records.statement: Determine the least positive integer $n_1$ and the greatest negative integer $n_2$ for which a $D(n_i)$-quintuple exists.

records.name: Triples having property D(n) for several parameters
records.statement: Are there infinitely many Diophantine triples that are also $D(n)$-triples for three distinct integers $n\ne1$?

records.name: Existence of a rational Diophantine septuple
records.statement: Does there exist a rational Diophantine septuple, that is, seven nonzero rational numbers whose pairwise products plus $1$ are rational squares?

records.name: Parameters admitting infinitely many rational D(q)-quintuples
records.statement: For which rational numbers $q$ do there exist infinitely many rational $D(q)$-quintuples?

records.name: Existence of a strong rational Diophantine quadruple
records.statement: Does there exist a set of four nonzero rational numbers $\{a_1,a_2,a_3,a_4\}$ such that $a_i a_j+1$ is a rational square for every $1\le i,j\le4$, including $i=j$?

records.name: Degree-only bounds for polynomial D(n)-tuples
records.statement: Let $P_n$ be the supremum of the sizes of nondegenerate polynomial $D(n)$-tuples over $\mathbb{Z}[X]$. Find an upper bound for $P_n$ depending only on $\deg n$, not on the coefficients of $n$.

records.name: Problem 1.1
records.statement:
Let $f\in\mathbb{Z}[X,Y]$ be a polynomial such that the equation $f(x,y)=0$ has only
finitely many solutions $(x,y)\in \mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}$. Give an upper bound for
$\max\{|x|,|y|\}$ when $(x,y)$ is such a solution, in terms of the degree of $f$
and of the maximal absolute value of the coefficients of $f$.

records.name: Conjecture 1.3 — Pillai
records.statement:
Let $k$ be a positive integer.
The equation
$$
x^p-y^q=k,
$$
where the unknowns $x$, $y$, $p$ and $q$ take integer values, all $\ge 2$, has only
finitely many solutions $(x,y,p,q)$.

records.name: Conjecture 1.4 — Shorey
records.statement:
There exists a positive number $C$ which depends only on $L$ and $H$ with the
following property. Let $m$, $x$ and $y$ be rational integers with $m\ge 2$ and
$|y|>1$ satisfying
$$
y^m=f(x).
$$
Then either $m\le C$, or else there is a proper subsum in
$$
y^m-b_1x^{n_1}-\cdots-b_{L-1}x^{n_{L-1}}-b_L
$$
which vanishes.

records.name: Conjecture 1.5
records.statement:
Let $k\ge 2$
be an integer and $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ be non-zero elements in a field
$K$ of zero characteristic, such that no quotient
$\alpha_i/\alpha_j$ with $j\not=i$ is a root of unity. Consider the
function
$$
F(X_1,\ldots,X_k)=
\det\pmatrix{
\alpha_1^{X_1}&\cdots&\alpha_k^{X_1}\cr
\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\cr
\alpha_1^{X_k}&\cdots&\alpha_k^{X_k}\cr
}.
$$
Then the equation
$$
F(0,x_2,\ldots,x_k)=0
$$
has only finitely many solutions $(x_2,\ldots,x_k)\in\mathbb{Z}^{k-1}$ such that
in the corresponding determinant, all
$(k-1)\times k$ and all $k\times (k-1)$ submatrices have rank $k-1$.

records.name: Conjecture 1.7
records.statement:
If there is no prime in
the interval
$[n+1,n+k]$, then the product $(n+1)\cdots(n+k)$ has at least $k$ distinct prime
divisors.

records.name: Conjecture 1.8 — Langevin
records.statement:
Given an increasing sequence $n_1<n_2<\cdots<n_k$ of
positive integers such that $n_1,n_2,\ldots,n_k$
are multiplicatively dependent, there exists
a prime number in the interval $[n_1,n_k]$.

records.name: Conjecture 1.9
records.statement:
Fix a positive integer $m$ for which
the equation
$$
m^2 + m_1^2 + m_2^2 = 3 mm_1m_2
$$
has a solution in positive integers $(m_1,m_2)$
with $0<m_1\le m_2\le m$. Then such a pair $(m_1,m_2)$ is unique.

records.name: Conjecture 2.2 — Erdős-Woods
records.statement:
There exists a positive integer $k$ such that, for $m$ and
$n$ positive integers, the conditions
$$
R(m+i)=R(n+i)\quad (i=0,\ldots,k-1)
$$
imply $m=n$.

records.name: Conjecture 2.3 — Erdős–Dressler
records.statement:
If $a$ and
$b$ are two positive integers with $a<b$ and
$R(a)=R(b)$ then there is a prime $p$ with $a< p< b$.

records.name: Conjecture 2.4 — Philippon
records.statement:
There exist real numbers $\varepsilon$, $\alpha$ and $\beta$ with
$0<\varepsilon<1/2$, $\alpha\ge 1$ and $\beta\ge 0$, and a positive integer
$B$, such that for any nonzero rational numbers $x$, $y$ satisfying
$xy^B\not=1$, the following is true: if $S$ denotes the set of prime numbers for which
$|xy^B+1|_p<1$, then
$$
-\sum_{p\in S}\log|xy^B+1|_p\le
B\Bigl(\alpha \mathrm{h}(x)+\varepsilon\mathrm{h}(y)+
\bigl(\alpha B+\varepsilon\bigr)\bigl(\beta+\sum_{p\in S}\log p\bigr)\Bigr).
$$

records.name: Conjecture 2.5 — Lang-Waldschmidt
records.statement:
For any $\varepsilon>0$, there
exists a constant $C(\varepsilon)>0$ such that, for any
nonzero rational integers $a_1,\ldots,a_m$, $b_1,\ldots,b_m$
with
$a_1^{b_1}\cdots a_m^{b_m}\not=1$,
$$
\left|a_1^{b_1}\cdots a_m^{b_m}-1\right|\ge
{C(\varepsilon)^m B\over (|b_1|\cdots |b_m|\cdot |a_1|\cdots
|a_m|)^{1+\varepsilon}},
$$
where
$B=\max_{1\le i\le m}|b_i|$.

records.name: Conjecture 2.6
records.statement:
For any
$\varepsilon>0$, there is a constant $C(\varepsilon)>0$ such that, for any positive
integers $x$,
$y$,
$p$, $q$ satisfying
$x^p\not= y^q$, the inequality
$$
|x^p-y^q| \ge C(\varepsilon)\max\{x^p, y^q\}^{1-(1/p)-(1/q)-\varepsilon}
$$
holds.

records.name: Conjecture 2.7 — Hall
records.statement:
If $x$
and $y$ are positive integers with $y^2\not=x^3$, then
$$
|y^2-x^3|\ge C\max\{y^2,x^3\}^{1/6}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 2.12
records.statement:
Let $\theta$ be real algebraic number of degree at least $3$.
Then inequality (2.11) has infinitely
many solutions in integers $p$ and $q$ with $q>0$
if and only if the integral
$$
\int_1^\infty \psi(x) dx
$$
diverges.

records.name: Conjecture 2.14 — Mahler
records.statement:
There exists an absolute constant $c>0$ such that
$$
\Vert \log a\Vert>a^{-c}
$$
for all integers $a\ge 2$.

records.name: Conjecture 2.15 — Mahler
records.statement:
Let $(\varepsilon_n)_{n\ge 0}$ be a sequence of elements in $\{0,1\}$. Assume
that the real number
$$
\sum_{n\ge 0}\varepsilon_n 3^{-n}
$$
is irrational, then it is transcendental.

records.name: Conjecture 3.2 — Roy
records.statement:
Let $k$ be a positive integer, $y_1,\ldots,y_k$ complex numbers which are
linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$, $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_k$ nonzero
complex numbers and $s_0,s_1,t_0,t_1,u$ positive real numbers
satisfying
$$
\max\{1,t_0,2t_1\} < \min\{s_0,2s_1\}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\max\{s_0,s_1+t_1\} < u < {1\over 2}(1+t_0+t_1).
$$
Assume that, for any sufficiently large positive integer $N$, there
exists a nonzero polynomial $P_N\in\mathbb{Z}[X_0,X_1]$ with partial degree
$\le N^{t_0}$ in $X_0$, partial degree $\le N^{t_1}$ in $X_1$ and
height $\le e^N$ which satisfies
$$
\Bigg| \big(\mathcal{D}^kP_N\big)
\Big(\sum_{j=1}^k m_jy_j,
\prod_{j=1}^k\alpha_j^{m_j} \Big) \Bigg|
\le \exp(-N^u)
$$
for any nonnegative integers $k$, $m_1,\ldots,m_k$ with $k\le N^{s_0}$
and $\max\{m_1,\ldots,m_k\}\le N^{s_1}$. Then, we have
$$
\operatorname{trdeg} \mathbb{Q}(y_1,\ldots,y_k, \alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_k) \ge k.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 3.3 — Algebraic Independence of Logarithms of Algebraic Numbers
records.statement:
Let $\lambda_1,\ldots, \lambda_n$ be
$\mathbb{Q}$-linearly independent complex numbers. Assume that the
numbers
$e^{\lambda_1},\ldots,e^{\lambda_n}$ are algebraic.
Then the
numbers $\lambda_1,\ldots, \lambda_n$ are algebraically
independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.4 — Strong Four Exponentials Conjecture
records.statement:
Let
$x_1,x_2$ be two
$\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-linearly independent complex numbers and
$y_1,y_2$ be also two
$\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-linearly independent complex numbers. Then at least
one of the four numbers
$x_1y_1$, $x_1y_2$, $x_2y_1$, $x_2y_2$ does not belong to
$\widetilde{\mathcal{L}}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.5 — Strong Five Exponentials Conjecture
records.statement:
Let $x_1, x_2$ be two $\mathbb{Q}$-linearly independent complex
numbers and
$y_1, y_2$ be also two $\mathbb{Q}$-linearly independent complex
numbers. Further let $\beta_{ij}$ \ ($ i=1,2$, $j=1,2$),
$\gamma_1$ and
$\gamma_2$ be six algebraic numbers with $\gamma_1\not=0$.
Assume that the five numbers
$$
e^{x_1y_1-\beta_{11}},\; e^{x_1y_2-\beta_{12}},\;
e^{x_2y_1-\beta_{21}},\; e^{x_2y_2-\beta_{22}},\;
e^{(\gamma_1 x_1/x_2)-\gamma_2}
$$
are algebraic.
Then all five exponents vanish:
$$
x_iy_j=\beta_{ij} \quad (i=1,2, \quad j=1,2)
\quad \text{ and }\quad \gamma_1 x_1=\gamma_2 x_2.
$$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.6 — Roy
records.statement:
For any $4\times 4$ skew-symmetric
matrix $\mathrm{M}$ with
entries in
$\mathcal{L}$ and rank $\le 2$, either the rows of $\mathrm{M}$ are
linearly dependent over $\mathbb{Q}$, or the column space of
$\mathrm{M}$ contains a nonzero element of $\mathbb{Q}^4$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.8 — Gel’fond
records.statement:
The two numbers
$$
\log\alpha\quad\text{and}\quad \alpha^\beta
$$
are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.9 — Schneider
records.statement:
The $d-1$
numbers
$$
\alpha^\beta,\; \alpha^{\beta^2},\ldots,
\alpha^{\beta^{d-1}}
$$
are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.10 — Gel’fond-Schneider
records.statement:
The $d$ numbers
$$
\log\alpha,\; \alpha^\beta,\; \alpha^{\beta^2},\ldots,
\alpha^{\beta^{d-1}}
$$
are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.11 — $p$-adic analog of Lindemann-Weierstrass's Theorem
records.statement:
Let $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n$
be
$p$-adic algebraic numbers in the domain of convergence of the $p$-adic
exponential function $\exp_p$. Then the
$n$ numbers $\exp_p\beta_1,\ldots, \exp_p\beta_n$ are algebraically
independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.12 — $p$-adic analog of an algebraic independence result of Gel’fond
records.statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a non-zero
algebraic number in the domain of convergence of the $p$-adic logarithm
$\log_p$, and let
$\beta$ be a
$p$-adic cubic algebraic number, such that $\beta\log_p\alpha$ is in the
domain of convergence of the $p$-adic exponential function $\exp_p$.
Then the two numbers
$$
\alpha^\beta=\exp_p(\beta\log_p\alpha)
\quad\text{and}\quad
\alpha^{\beta^2}=\exp_p(\beta^2\log_p\alpha)
$$
are algebraically independent
over
$\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.13 — Blum, Cucker, Shub and Smale
records.statement:
Given an absolute constant $c$ and polynomials $P_1,\ldots,P_m$ with a
total of $N$ coefficients and no common complex zeros, there is no program
to find, in at most $N^c$ step, the coefficients of polynomials
$A_i$ satisfying B\'ezout's relation
$$
A_1P_1+\cdots+A_mP_m=1.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 3.14
records.statement:
Let $\Sigma$ be a finite subset of $\mathbb{C}^n$ and
$\varepsilon$ a positive number. There exists a positive number
$r_0(\Sigma,\varepsilon)$ such that, for any positive integer $t$ and any entire
function $f$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$ which vanishes on $\Sigma$ with multiplicity $\ge t$,
$$
\Theta_f(r)\ge \omega_t(\Sigma)-t\varepsilon
\quad\text{for}\quad r\ge r_0(\Sigma,\varepsilon).
$$

records.name: Conjecture 3.15 — Goncharov
records.statement:
As a $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra, $\mathfrak{Z}$ is the direct sum of
$\mathfrak{Z}_p$ for $p\ge 0$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.17
records.statement:
The numbers
$\pi$,
$\zeta(3),\zeta(5),\ldots,\zeta(2n+1),\ldots$ are algebraically
independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.18
records.statement:
At least three of the four numbers
$$
\pi,\; \Gamma(1/5),\; \Gamma(2/5), \; e^{\pi\sqrt 5}
$$
are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 3.19 — Rohrlich
records.statement:
$\overline{G}$ is a universal odd distribution with values in groups where
multiplication by $2$ is invertible.

records.name: Conjecture 3.20 — Nesterenko
records.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathbb{C}$ have positive imaginary part.
Assume that $\tau$ is not quadratic.
Set $q=e^{2i\pi\tau}$.
Then at least $4$ of the $5$ numbers
$$
\tau,\; q,\; P(q),\; Q(q),\; R(q)
$$
are algebraically independent.

records.name: Conjecture 3.21 — Bertolin
records.statement:
Let $\mathcal{E}_1,\ldots,\mathcal{E}_n$ be pairwise non isogeneous elliptic curves with modular invariants $j(\mathcal{E}_h)$. For $h=1,\ldots,n$, let $\omega_{1h},\omega_{2h}$ be a pair of fundamental periods of $\wp_h$ with $\eta_{1h},\eta_{2h}$ the associated quasi-periods, $P_{ih}$ points on $\mathcal{E}_h(\mathbb{C})$ and $p_{ih}$ (resp. $d_{ih}$) elliptic integrals of the first (resp. second) kind associated to $P_{ih}$. Define $\kappa_h=[k_h:\mathbb{Q}]$ and let $d_h$ be the dimension of the $k_h$-subspace of $\mathbb{C}/(k_h\omega_{1h}+k_h\omega_{2h})$ spanned by $p_{1h},\ldots,p_{r_hh}$. Then the transcendence degree of the field
$$
\mathbb{Q}\Bigl(\bigl\{
j(\mathcal{E}_h), \omega_{1h},\omega_{2h}, \eta_{1h},\eta_{2h},
P_{ih}, p_{ih}, d_{ih}
\bigr\}_{1\le i\le r_h \atop 1\le h\le n}
\Bigr)
$$
is at least
$$
2\sum_{h=1}^n d_h
+4\sum_{h=1}^n \kappa_h^{-1}-n+1.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 3.23
records.statement:
Given an
elliptic curve with Weierstrass equation
$y^2=4x^3-g_2x-g_3$, a nonzero period $\omega$, the associated quasi-period
$\eta$ of the zeta function and a complex number $u$ which is not a pole of
$\wp$, we have
$$
\operatorname{trdeg}\mathbb{Q}
\bigl(g_2,g_3,\pi/\omega,\wp(u),\zeta(u)-(\eta/\omega)u\bigr)\ge 2.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 3.24 — Bertrand
records.statement:
Let $q_1,\ldots,q_n$ be nonzero algebraic numbers in the unit open disc such
that the $3n$ numbers
$$
J(q_i), \; DJ(q_i),\; D^2J(q_i)\qquad (i=1,\ldots,n)
$$
are algebraically dependent over $\mathbb{Q}$. Then there exist two indices $i\not =
j$ \ ($1\le i\le n$, $1\le j\le n$) such that $q_i$ and $q_j$ are
multiplicatively dependent.

records.name: Conjecture 3.25 — Bertrand
records.statement:
Let $q_1$ and $q_2$ be two nonzero algebraic numbers in the unit open disc.
Suppose that there is an irreducible element $P\in\mathbb{Q}[X,Y]$ such that
$$
P\bigl(J(q_1),J(q_2)\bigr)=0.
$$
Then there exist a constant $c$ and a positive integer $s$ such that
$P=c\Phi_s$, where $\Phi_s$ is the modular polynomial of level $s$. Moreover
$q_1$ and $q_2$ are
multiplicatively dependent.

records.name: Conjecture 3.26
records.statement:
Is there such a bound
depending polynomially on the degree and height of $P$?

records.name: Question 3.27 — Mahler
records.statement:
Are there entire transcendental functions $f(z)$ such
that if $x$ is a Liouville number then so is $f(x)$?

records.name: Conjecture 4.1 — Lehmer's Problem
records.statement:
There exists
a positive absolute constant $c$ such that,
for any
nonzero algebraic number $\alpha$ which
is not a root of unity,
$$
\mathrm{M}(\alpha)\ge 1+c.
$$
Equivalently, there exists
a positive absolute constant $c$ such that,
for any
nonzero algebraic number $\alpha$ of degree at most $d$ which
is not a root of unity,
$$
\mathrm{h}(\alpha)\ge {c\over d}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.3 — Amoroso-David
records.statement:
For each positive integer $n\ge 1$ there
exists a positive number $c(n)$ having the
following property. Let $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ be
multiplicatively independent algebraic numbers. Define
$D=[\mathbb{Q}(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n): \mathbb{Q}]$. Then
$$
\prod_{i=1}^n\mathrm{h}(\alpha_i)\ge{c(n)\over D}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.4 — Amoroso-David
records.statement:
For each
positive integer
$n\ge 1$ there exists a positive number $c(n)$ such that, if
$\underline{\alpha}=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ is a $n$-tuple of
multiplicatively independent algebraic numbers, then
$$
\mathrm{h}(1\colon \alpha_1\colon \cdots\colon
\alpha_n)\ge{c(n)\over
\omega(\underline{\alpha})}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.5 — Amoroso-David
records.statement:
For each integer $n\ge 1$ there exists a positive constant $c(n)$
such that, for any algebraic subvariety $V$ of $\mathbb{G}_m^n$ which is
defined over $\mathbb{Q}$, which is $\mathbb{Q}$-irreducible, and which is not a
union of translates of algebraic subgroups by torsion points, we have
$$
\hat{h}(V)\ge c(n)\deg(V)^{(s-\dim V-1)/(s-\dim V)},
$$
where $s$ is the dimension of the smallest algebraic subgroup of
$\mathbb{G}_m^n$ containing $V$.

records.name: Problem 4.6
records.statement:
For $\theta\in(0,\pi)$, define
$$
V_\theta=\{re^{it}\; ;\;
r>0,\; |t|>\theta\}.
$$
Compute $L(V_\theta)$ in terms of $\theta$.

records.name: Conjecture 4.7 — David-Hindry
records.statement:
There exists a positive constant
$c$, depending only on $A$ and $\mathcal{L}$, such that for any $P\in A(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$
which has infinite order modulo any abelian subvariety, we have
$$
\hat{h}_{\mathcal{L}}(P)\ge c \delta(P)^{-1}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.11 — Wirsing and Schmidt
records.statement:
For any positive integer
$n$ and any real number $\theta$ which is
either transcendental or else is algebraic of degree $>n$, there exists a
positive constant $c=c(n,\theta)$ with the following property:
there exist infinitely many algebraic numbers $\gamma$ of degree $\le n$
for which
$$
0<|\theta-\gamma|<c\mathrm{H}(\gamma)^{-n-1}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.12
records.statement:
Let $\underline{\theta}=(\theta_1,\ldots,\theta_m)$ be a $m$-tuple of
complex numbers. Define
$$
t=\operatorname{trdeg} \mathbb{Q}(\underline{\theta})
$$
and assume $t\ge 1$. There
exist positive constants
$c_1$ and
$c_2$ with the following property.
Let $(D_\nu)_{\nu\ge 0}$ and $(\mu_\nu)_{\nu\ge 0}$
be sequences of real numbers satisfying
$$
c_1\le D_\nu\le \mu_\nu,\quad
D_\nu\le D_{\nu+1}\le 2 D_\nu,
\quad
\mu_\nu\le \mu_{\nu+1}\le 2 \mu_\nu
\qquad (\nu\ge 0).
$$
Assume also that the sequence $(\mu_\nu)_{\nu\ge 0}$ is
unbounded. Then for infinitely many
$\nu$ there exists a $m$-tuple $(\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_m)$
of algebraic numbers satisfying
$$
[\mathbb{Q}(\underline{\gamma}):\mathbb{Q}]\le D_\nu,
\quad
\mu(\underline{\gamma})\le \mu_\nu
$$
and
$$
\max_{1\le i\le m}|\theta_i-\gamma_i|\le \exp\{- c_2
D_\nu^{ 1/t }
\mu_\nu\}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.13 — Laurent-Roy
records.statement:
Let $\theta\in\mathbb{C}^m$. There is a positive constant
$c$, depending only on $\theta$ and $m$, with the following property. Let $k$
be an integer with
$0\le k\le m$. For infinitely many integers
$T\ge 1$, there exists an algebraic set $Z\subset\mathbb{C}^m$, defined over $\mathbb{Q}$,
of dimension $k$, and a point $\alpha\in Z$, such that
$$
t(Z)\le T^{m-k}\quad\text{and}\quad
|\theta-\alpha|\le \exp\{-cT^{m+1}\}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.14
records.statement:
There exist two positive absolute
constants $c_1$ and $c_2$ with the following property. Let
$\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_m$ be logarithms of algebraic
numbers with
$\alpha_i=e^{\lambda_i}$ \ ($1\le i\le m$), let $\beta_0,\ldots,
\beta_m$ be algebraic numbers, $D$ the degree of the number field
$$
\mathbb{Q}(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_m,\beta_0,\ldots,\beta_m)
$$
and finally
let $h\ge 1/D$ satisfy
$$
h\ge \max_{1\le i\le m} \mathrm{h}(\alpha_i), \quad
h\ge {1\over D}\max_{1\le i\le m}|\lambda_i|
\quad\text{and}\quad
h\ge \max_{0\le j\le m} \mathrm{h}(\beta_j).
$$
(1) Assume that the number
$$
\Lambda=\beta_0+\beta_1\lambda_1+\cdots+\beta_m\lambda_m
$$
is nonzero. Then
$$
|\Lambda|\ge
\exp\bigl\{-c_1mD^2h \bigr\}.
$$
(2) Assume $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_m$ are linearly independent
over $\mathbb{Q}$. Then
$$
\sum_{i=1}^m|\lambda_i-\beta_i|\ge
\exp\bigl\{-c_2mD^{1+(1/m)}h \bigr\}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.15
records.statement:
There exists a
positive absolute constant
$C$ with the following property.
Let
$\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ be nonzero algebraic numbers and
$\log\alpha_1,\ldots,\log\alpha_n$ logarithms of
$\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ respectively. Assume that the numbers
$\log\alpha_1,\ldots,\log\alpha_n$ are $\mathbb{Q}$-linearly independent. Let
$\beta_0,\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n$ be algebraic numbers, not all of which are zero.
Denote by $D$ the degree of the number field
$$
\mathbb{Q}(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n,\beta_0,\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n)
$$
over
$\mathbb{Q}$. Further, let $A_1,\ldots,A_n$ and $B$ be positive
real numbers, each $\ge e$, such that
$$
\log A_j\ge\max\left\{\mathrm{h}(\alpha_j),\ {|\log\alpha_j|\over
D}, \ {1\over D}\right\}
\quad (1\le j\le n),
$$
$$
B\ge\max_{1\le j\le n-1}
\mathrm{h}(\beta_j).
$$
Then the number
$$
\Lambda=\beta_0+\beta_1\log\alpha_1+\cdots+\beta_n\log\alpha_n
$$
satisfies
$$
|\Lambda|>
\exp\{-C^n
D^{n+2}(\log A_1)\cdots (\log A_n)(\log B+\log D) (\log D)\}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.16 — Quantitative Refinement of Schanuel's Conjecture
records.statement:
Let $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ be $\mathbb{Q}$-linearly independent
complex numbers.
Assume that for any $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a positive number $H_0$ such
that, for any $H\ge H_0$ and $n$-tuple $(h_1,\ldots,h_n)$ of rational integers
satisfying $0<\max\{|h_1|,\ldots,|h_n|\}\le H$, the inequality
$$
|h_1x_1+\cdots+h_nx_n|\ge
\exp\bigl\{- H^\varepsilon\bigr\}
$$
holds.
Let $d$ be a
positive integer. Then there exists a positive number
$C=C(x_1,\ldots,x_n,d)$ with the following property: for any integer $H\ge 2$ and
any $n+1$ tuple
$P_1,\ldots,P_{n+1}$ of polynomials in $\mathbb{Z}[X_1,\ldots,X_n,Y_1,\ldots,Y_n]$ with
degrees
$\le d$ and usual heights $\le H$, which generate an ideal of
$\mathbb{Q}[X_1,\ldots,X_n,Y_1,\ldots,Y_n]$ of rank
$n+1$, we have
$$
\sum_{j=1}^{n+1}\bigl|P_j(x_1,\ldots,x_n,e^{x_1},\ldots, e^{x_n})\bigr|\ge H^{-C}.
$$

records.name: Question 4.17 — Mazur
records.statement:
Assume that
$K=\mathbb{Q}$ and that
$V(\mathbb{Q})$ is Zariski dense; is
$Z$ a union of connected components of $V(\mathbb{R})$?

records.name: Conjecture 4.18
records.statement:
Let $A$ be a simple abelian variety over $\mathbb{Q}$,
$\exp_A:\mathbb{R}^g\rightarrow A(\mathbb{R})^0$ the exponential map of the Lie group
$A(\mathbb{R})^0$ and
$\Omega=\mathbb{Z}\omega_1+\cdots+\mathbb{Z}\omega_g$ its kernel. Let
$u=u_1\omega_1+\cdots+u_g\omega_g\in\mathbb{R}^g$ satisfy $\exp_A(u)\in A(\mathbb{Q})$.
Then $1,u_1,\ldots,u_g$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

records.name: Conjecture 4.19
records.statement:
Let $A$ be a simple Abelian
variety of dimension
$g$ over a number field
$K$ embedded in $\mathbb{R}$. Denote by $\ell$ the rank over $\mathbb{Z}$ of the
Mordell-Weil group $A(K)$. For any $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $h_0>0$ (which
depends only on the Abelian variety
$A$, the real number field
$K$ and
$\varepsilon$) such that, for any $h\ge h_0$ and any $\zeta\in A(\mathbb{R})^0$, there is a
point $\gamma\in A(K)$ with N\'eron-Tate height $\le
h$ such that
$$
\operatorname{dist}(\zeta,\gamma)
\le h^{-(\ell/2g)+\varepsilon}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 4.20
records.statement:
Let $m$, $n$, $k$ be positive integers and $a_{ij\kappa}$ rational integers
($1\le i\le n$, $1\le j\le m$, $1\le\kappa\le k$). For
$\underline{x}=(x_1,\ldots,x_k)\in\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^k$ denote by $\Gamma(\underline{x})$
the following finitely generated subgroup of $\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^n$:
$$
\Gamma(\underline{x})=\left\{
\left(
\prod_{j=1}^m \prod_{\kappa=1}^k x_k^{a_{ij\kappa}s_j}\right)_{1\le i\le n}
\; ;\;
\underline{s}=(s_1,\ldots,s_m)\in\mathbb{Z}^m\right\}.
$$
Assume there exists $\underline{x} \in\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^k$ such that
$\Gamma(\underline{x})$ is dense in $\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^n$. Then for any
$\underline{\gamma}=(\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_k)$ in
$\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^k$ with $\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_k$ algebraic and
multiplicatively independent, the subgroup $\Gamma(\underline{\gamma})$ is dense in
$\bigl(\mathbb{R}_+^\times\bigr)^n$.

records.name: Conjecture 4.21
records.statement:
For any
$\varepsilon>0$ there exists $S_0>0$ (depending on $\varepsilon$,
$\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_m$ and $\mathcal{K}$) such that, for any $S\ge S_0$ and any
$\underline{\zeta}\in\mathcal{K}$, there exists $\underline{s}\in\mathbb{Z}^m$ with $|\underline{s}|\le S$ and
$$
\max_{1\le i\le n} |\gamma_i(\underline{s})-\zeta_i|\le
S^{-1-(1/n)+\varepsilon}.
$$

records.name: Question 5.2 — Bugeaud
records.statement:
Let $n \ge 2$. Denote by
$\mathrm{ZH}_n$ the set of real numbers $\xi$ with the following property: there
exists $c_1(\xi) >0$ and
$c_2(\xi)>0$ such that for algebraic number
$\alpha$ of degree $\le n$,
$$
|\xi-\alpha|\ge c_2(\xi) \mathrm{H}(\alpha)^{-n-1},
$$
and such that there are infinitely many algebraic numbers
$\alpha$ of degree $\le n$ with
$$
|\xi-\alpha|\le c_1(\xi) \mathrm{H}(\alpha)^{-n-1},
$$
Do the set $\mathrm{ZH}_n$ strictly contain the set of algebraic numbers of
degree $n+1$?

records.name: Conjecture 5.3
records.statement:
Let $n$ be a positive
integer. For almost all $n$-tuples $(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$, there are
positive constants
$c$ and $D_0$ (depending on $n$, $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ and $\varepsilon$),
with the following property. For any integer $D\ge D_0$, any real number
$\mu\ge D$ and any $2n$-tuple
$\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n,\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n$ of algebraic numbers
satisfying
$$
[\mathbb{Q}( \alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n,\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n):\mathbb{Q}]\le D
$$
and
$$
[\mathbb{Q}( \alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n,\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n):\mathbb{Q}]
\max\left\{\mathrm{h}(\alpha_i),\; \mathrm{h}(\beta_i)\; ; \; 1\le i\le n\right\}\le\mu,
$$
we have
$$
\max\left\{|x_i-\beta_i|,\;
|e^{x_i}-\alpha_i|\; ; \; {1\le i\le n}\right\}
\ge \exp\{-c D^{1/(2n)}\mu\}.
$$

records.name: Conjecture 5.4 — Loxton and van der Poorten
records.statement:
Let $(n_i)_{i\ge 0}$ be an
increasing sequence of positive integers. Assume there is a prime
number $p$ such that the power series
$$
\sum_{i\ge 0}z^{n_i}\in\mathbb{F}_p[[z]]
$$
is algebraic over $\mathbb{F}_p(z)$ and irrational (not in $\mathbb{F}_p(z)$). Then the real
number
$$
\sum_{i\ge 0}10^{-n_i}
$$
is transcendental.

records.name: Fast evaluation of high-degree elliptic-curve isogenies
records.statement: Given an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{F}_q$ and $P\in E(\mathbb{F}_q)$, characterize maps or isogenies $\psi:E\to E'$ for which $\psi(P)$ can be evaluated in time polynomial in $\log\deg\psi$ and $\log q$, ideally $O(\log\deg\psi\,\log^2q)$.

records.name: Cryptographically useful bilinear structures
records.statement: Find bilinear structures that are useful for cryptographic constructions.

records.name: Efficient class-group realizations of large cyclic groups
records.statement: Find orders $\mathcal{O}$ whose Picard groups contain $\mathbb{Z}/\ell$, admit compact element representations, and allow group composition in $O(\log\ell)$ operations.

records.name: Explicit class-group realization of finite-field discrete logarithms
records.statement: Make the proposed realization of existing finite-field discrete-logarithm systems inside class groups explicit for practical systems.

records.name: Security consequences of Weil descent for the class-group realization
records.statement: Determine whether Weil descent compromises the security of the proposed class-group realization of finite-field discrete-logarithm systems.

records.name: Fast Tate–Lichtenbaum pairing computation
records.statement: Develop a fast algorithm to compute the Tate–Lichtenbaum pairing $T_n$.

records.name: Computational realization of a second cohomology group
records.statement: Turn $H^2(G_K,K_s^*)$ into an explicitly computational group.

records.name: Explicit cocycles and invariants for split local algebras
records.statement: Explicitly describe the cocycle $c_u$, equivalently fast-compute invariants of local algebras split by the generalized-dihedral extensions specified in the slides.

records.name: Globalizing prescribed local Brauer classes
records.statement: Explicitly construct global algebras or Brauer classes with prescribed local data, especially when the local splitting fields are dihedral.

records.name: Schoof-type zeta computation without bad genus dependence
records.statement: Adapt Schoof's method to compute zeta functions of curves without unfavorable dependence on the genus.

records.name: Polynomial-time curve zeta computation in genus and field size
records.statement: Is computation of a curve's zeta function polynomial simultaneously in the genus $g$ and in $\log q$?

records.name: Cup-product pairings in zeta computation
records.statement: Determine whether natural de Rham cup-product pairings can be used to improve zeta-function computations.

records.name: Removing restrictions from hyperelliptic zeta algorithms
records.statement: Remove the imaginary-hyperelliptic and $p\ne2$ restrictions from the complexity bound stated in the slides.

records.name: Improved Frobenius lifts for nondegenerate curves
records.statement: Test and analyze whether deleting extra points and fixing the lift $x\mapsto x^p$ improves Frobenius lifts for nondegenerate curves.

records.name: Higher-dimensional nondegenerate Frobenius algorithms
records.statement: Develop the higher-dimensional analogue of the nondegenerate-curve Frobenius-lift method.

records.name: Useful deformations for nondegenerate curves
records.statement: Find useful deformations of nondegenerate curves together with easy starting matrices for Frobenius computation.

records.name: Nondegenerate surfaces in toric threefolds
records.statement: Work out effective zeta-function computations for nondegenerate surfaces in toric threefolds.

records.name: Factoring structured semiprimes from fewer known bits
records.statement: Factor $N=p^rq^s$ with $r\approx s$ using fewer known bits of the factors than existing methods require.

records.name: Factoring a three-prime integer from fewer known bits
records.statement: Factor $N=pqr$ from fewer known bits of its prime factors.

records.name: Factoring from nonconsecutive known bits
records.statement: Develop methods to factor an integer when the known bits of its factors are nonconsecutive.

records.name: Reducing guesses in factoring with known bits
records.statement: Reduce the number of guesses required by lattice attacks for factoring with partially known bits.

records.name: Learning from wrong guesses in partial-key factoring
records.statement: Extract useful information from incorrect guesses in factoring attacks based on partially known bits.

records.name: Roots of x-squared minus one modulo a composite
records.statement: Efficiently solve for, or characterize all relevant roots of, $x^2-1$ modulo a composite integer $N$ in the setting of the slides.

records.name: Faster Coppersmith root methods
records.statement: Improve the running time of Coppersmith-type methods for finding small modular or integer roots.

records.name: Polynomial-shape dependence in small-root algorithms
records.statement: Understand and control how the shape of a polynomial affects Coppersmith-type small-root algorithms.

records.name: Algebraic independence in multivariate elimination
records.statement: Give conditions or constructions that ensure algebraic independence in multivariate elimination for small-root attacks.

records.name: Optimal polynomial collections for lattice attacks
records.statement: Find an optimal collection of polynomials for multivariate lattice-based small-root attacks.

records.name: Dimension reduction in small-root lattices
records.statement: Determine whether the lattice dimension in the stated small-root constructions can be reduced.

records.name: Zero-constant-term Newton-polytope case
records.statement: Resolve the zero-constant-term case in the Newton-polytope formulation of multivariate small-root methods.

records.name: Cryptographic primitives from hard small roots
records.statement: Construct additional cryptographic primitives whose security follows from the hardness of finding small roots.

records.name: Quality of rotation-augmented cyclic-lattice reduction
records.statement: Analyze how effective rotation-augmented lattice reduction is on cyclic or NTRU lattices.

records.name: Faster cyclic-lattice reduction
records.statement: Speed up rotation-augmented reduction algorithms for cyclic or NTRU lattices.

records.name: Fast construction of five-term geometric progressions for NFS
records.statement: For large $N$, efficiently find the required short five-term geometric progressions modulo $N$ that avoid first- and second-order recurrence, thereby producing two cubic NFS polynomials with a common root and coefficients $O(N^{1/6})$.

records.name: Distribution of elliptic-curve group structures
records.statement: Study the distribution of group structures $E(\mathbb{F}_q)$ as elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{F}_q$ vary; in particular, determine the correct nonuniform law.

records.name: Typical exponent of an elliptic-curve group
records.statement: Is the exponent $e_q(E)$ of $E(\mathbb{F}_q)$ typically close to $q$?

records.name: Frequency of cyclic elliptic-curve groups
records.statement: How often is the group of a random elliptic curve over $\mathbb{F}_q$ cyclic?

records.name: Typical arithmetic structure of elliptic-curve orders
records.statement: Characterize the typical arithmetic structure of $\#E(\mathbb{F}_q)$ for elliptic curves over finite fields.

records.name: Prime-order curves over every finite field
records.statement: Prove that there are sufficiently many prime-order elliptic curves over every finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.

records.name: Prime extension-degree quotients of elliptic-curve orders
records.statement: For a fixed $E/\mathbb{F}_q$, prove that $\#E(\mathbb{F}_{q^n})/\#E(\mathbb{F}_q)$ is prime for infinitely many $n$.

records.name: Prime reductions of elliptic curves over the rationals
records.statement: For a torsion-free elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$, prove that $\#E(\mathbb{F}_p)$ is prime for infinitely many primes $p$.

records.name: Elliptic curves with smooth group order
records.statement: Prove that sufficiently many elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{F}_p$ have smooth group order $\#E(\mathbb{F}_p)$.

records.name: Elliptic-curve orders with a large prime divisor
records.statement: Quantify elliptic curves over finite fields whose group order has a large prime divisor.

records.name: Distribution of elliptic-curve pseudorandom sequences
records.statement: Prove the conjecture that the EC-LCG, EC-PG, and EC-NRG sequences defined in the slides are very well distributed.

records.name: Constructing an elliptic curve of prescribed order over a fixed field
records.statement: Given integers $n$ and a prime power $q$, construct, when possible, an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{F}_q$ with $\#E(\mathbb{F}_q)=n$.

records.name: Choosing a field for an elliptic curve of prescribed order
records.statement: Given $n$, efficiently choose a prime power $q$ and construct an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{F}_q$ with $\#E(\mathbb{F}_q)=n$.

records.name: Jacobians in abelian-threefold isogeny classes
records.statement: Given the Weil polynomial of an abelian-threefold isogeny class over a finite field, determine whether the class contains a Jacobian.

records.name: Recognizing genus-three Jacobians over the base field
records.statement: Decide whether a given principally polarized abelian threefold over a field $k$ is the Jacobian of a curve over $k$.

records.name: Effective representation of principally polarized abelian threefolds
records.statement: Give an effective input representation for a principally polarized abelian threefold suitable for deciding whether it is a Jacobian.

records.name: Detecting Jacobians via criteria and Deligne modules
records.statement: Combine the Meagher–Ritzenthaler criteria with Deligne modules to detect Jacobians in an ordinary absolutely simple abelian-threefold isogeny class.

records.name: Monotonicity of maximal curve point counts in genus
records.statement: For fixed $q$, is $N_q(g)=\max_C\#C(\mathbb{F}_q)$ increasing as a function of the genus $g$?

records.name: Shortest vectors in Hermitian lattices
records.statement: Find a sharp upper bound for the shortest-vector length in an $n$-dimensional positive-definite Hermitian space of determinant $d$ over an imaginary quadratic principal ideal domain.

records.name: Faster pairing computation
records.statement: Speed up the computation of cryptographic pairings.

records.name: More MNT and pairing-friendly elliptic curves
records.statement: Find more MNT curves, including usable larger embedding degrees, more curve families, and smaller cofactors.

records.name: Pairing-friendly hyperelliptic curves
records.statement: Construct pairing-friendly hyperelliptic curves suitable for cryptography.

records.name: Genus-four pairing speed-security tradeoff
records.statement: Determine the exact computational-speed and security tradeoff for genus-four curves used in pairing cryptography.

records.name: Breaking the pairing system
records.statement: Find an attack that breaks the pairing-based cryptographic system discussed in the slides, or establish its resistance to known attacks.

records.name: Breaking weaker pairing assumptions
records.statement: Break, or determine the true hardness of, the weaker security assumptions used in pairing-based cryptography.

records.name: Taxonomy of pairing-related assumptions
records.statement: Update Joux's 2002 work by developing a systematic taxonomy of pairing-related computational assumptions.

records.name: Decision Linear versus DDH
records.statement: Is the Decision Linear problem strictly harder than the decisional Diffie–Hellman problem in the relevant pairing groups?

records.name: Pairing signatures without distortion maps
records.statement: Give the cited pairing-based signature constructions and their security proofs without relying on distortion maps.

records.name: Hardness of the Pairing Inversion Problem
records.statement: Determine the computational hardness of the Pairing Inversion Problem.

records.name: Polynomial-factor hardness of general lattice problems
records.statement: Prove that general SVP and SIVP are hard in the worst case to approximate within small polynomial factors.

records.name: Polynomial-factor hardness of ideal-lattice problems
records.statement: Prove an analogous small-polynomial-factor worst-case hardness result for SVP and SIVP on ideal lattices.

records.name: NP-hardness of ideal-lattice SVP
records.statement: Is the shortest vector problem on ideal or cyclic lattices NP-hard, either exactly or under approximation?

records.name: NP-hardness of minimum distance for cyclic codes
records.statement: Is the minimum-distance problem for cyclic codes NP-hard?

records.name: Reducing arbitrary lattices to ideal lattices
records.statement: Reduce computational problems on arbitrary lattices to corresponding problems on cyclic or ideal lattices.

records.name: SVP-to-CVP reduction within ideal lattices
records.statement: Does SVP reduce to CVP while remaining inside the class of cyclic or ideal lattices?

records.name: Worst cases for LLL on ideal lattices
records.statement: Exhibit cyclic or ideal lattices on which LLL achieves its worst-case approximation factor.

records.name: An algebraic LLL algorithm
records.statement: Develop an algebraic analogue of the LLL lattice-reduction algorithm that exploits ideal-lattice structure.

records.name: Ideal-lattice pseudorandom generators
records.statement: Construct efficient pseudorandom generators from ideal-lattice problems.

records.name: Ideal-lattice pseudorandom functions
records.statement: Construct efficient pseudorandom functions from ideal-lattice problems.

records.name: Ideal-lattice digital signatures
records.statement: Construct efficient digital-signature schemes from ideal-lattice problems.

records.name: Worst-case security of quasi-cyclic cryptosystems
records.statement: Prove that quasi-cyclic lattice or code public-key constructions are secure based on worst-case hardness for quasi-cyclic structures.

records.name: Algebraic algorithms for ideal-lattice problems
records.statement: Use algebraic tools to solve computational problems on ideal lattices efficiently.

records.name: Lattice reduction for algebraic-number-theory problems
records.statement: Use lattice reduction together with average-case problems to solve computational problems in algebraic number theory.

records.name: Cryptography from worst-case algebraic-number-theory hardness
records.statement: Base cryptographic constructions directly on worst-case hardness assumptions from algebraic number theory.

records.name: Quantum algorithm for Smallest Conjugate
records.statement: Develop an efficient quantum algorithm for the Smallest Conjugate problem.

records.name: Quantum algorithm for ideal-lattice SVP
records.statement: Develop an efficient quantum algorithm for the shortest vector problem on ideal lattices.

records.name: Ideal-lattice Regev cryptosystem
records.statement: Construct an efficient ideal-lattice version of Regev's quantum-SVP-based cryptosystem.

records.name: Non-malleability of real RSA key generators
records.statement: Use number theory to prove non-malleability properties for real-world RSA key-generation algorithms.

records.name: Malleable RSA modulus generation
records.statement: Construct a malleable RSA generator producing publicly related moduli $n,n'$ such that factoring $n'$ makes $n$ easy to factor.

records.name: Practical trapdoor discrete-logarithm groups
records.statement: Construct practical groups in which discrete logarithms have an effective trapdoor.

records.name: Groups with infeasible inversion
records.statement: Construct groups in which inversion is infeasible under reasonable cryptographic assumptions.

records.name: Better trapdoor pairings
records.statement: Construct improved practical trapdoor pairings.

records.name: Security of the TGII directed-signature construction
records.statement: Prove the simple construction from trapdoor groups with infeasible inversion to directed transitive signatures secure, or repair the construction.

records.name: Finiteness of a Shafarevich–Tate group needed by the lifting method
records.statement: Prove finiteness of the Shafarevich–Tate group of the elliptic-curve lift required by the Huang–Raskind method, in the general cases where it is not known.

records.name: Faster infrastructure discrete logarithms and point counting
records.statement: Use a baby-step/giant-step infrastructure framework to speed infrastructure discrete logarithms or point counting by a polynomial factor.

records.name: Converting between divisor-class and infrastructure discrete logarithms
records.statement: Give efficient reductions in both directions between the degree-zero divisor-class-group discrete logarithm problem and the infrastructure discrete logarithm problem.

records.name: Necessity of the odd-class-number condition for Heegner bounds
records.statement: Is the odd-class-number condition in the stated lower bound for Heegner points necessary?

records.name: Necessity of the no-CM condition for Heegner bounds
records.statement: Is the no-complex-multiplication condition in the stated lower bound for Heegner points necessary?

records.name: Heegner points from nonmaximal orders
records.statement: Prove analogues of the stated Heegner-point results for points arising from nonmaximal orders.

records.name: Deuring lifting for Darmon–Heegner points
records.statement: Find an analogue of the Deuring Lifting Theorem for Darmon–Heegner points.

records.name: Growing-degree improvements to the lifting attack
records.statement: Can the lifting attack be improved by allowing the number-field degree $[K:\mathbb{Q}]$ to grow?

records.name: Explicit test homogeneous spaces of prescribed ramification
records.statement: Explicitly construct test elements or principal homogeneous spaces having prescribed ramification and a prescribed large prime order $\ell$.

records.name: Implicit computation with testing characters and homogeneous spaces
records.statement: Work efficiently with the testing characters and principal homogeneous spaces without constructing them explicitly.

records.name: Tractable special cases of the signature problem
records.statement: Identify and solve tractable special cases of the signature problem described in the slides.

records.name: Trapdoor-free security from multiple nearby RSA moduli
records.statement: For nearby moduli $n_i=n_1+d_i$ and maps $f_i(r)=r^{e_i}\bmod n_i$, prove the conjecture that with sufficiently many components at least one $f_i$ is not polynomial-time invertible, thereby validating the proposed trapdoor-free RSA-like probabilistic function.

records.name: Vandiver's conjecture
records.statement: For a prime $p$, conjecturally $p$ does not divide the class number of the maximal real subfield $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_p+\overline{\zeta_p})$ of the $p$th cyclotomic field.

records.name: Nonvanishing of the p-adic zeta function at even integers
records.statement: Let $\zeta_p:\mathbb{Z}_p\to\mathbb{Q}_p$ be the $p$-adic zeta function. Is $\zeta_p(k)\ne0$ for every even integer $k$?

records.name: Congruent number decision problem
records.statement: Given an integer $n$, determine whether there are rational numbers $x,y,z$ satisfying $x^2+y^2=z^2$ and $xy=2n$; equivalently, determine whether $n$ is the area of a right triangle with rational sides.

records.name: Congruent numbers in residue classes 5, 6, and 7 modulo 8
records.statement: Is every integer $n\equiv5,6,$ or $7\pmod 8$ a congruent number?

records.name: L-value criterion for congruent numbers
records.statement: For $E_n:y^2=x^3-n^2x$, is $n$ a congruent number if and only if $L(E_n,1)=0$?

records.name: Infinitude of rational points on an elliptic curve
records.statement: Given an elliptic curve $E:y^2=x^3+Ax+B$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, determine whether $E$ has infinitely many rational points.

records.name: Bounded prime-sum criterion for rational points
records.statement: For an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$, let $N_p$ be its number of solutions modulo $p$ plus one and put $f(X)=\sum_{p\le X}\log(N_p/p)$. Is $f(X)$ bounded if and only if $E(\mathbb{Q})$ is finite?

records.name: Prime-sum growth and elliptic-curve rank
records.statement: For an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$ of rank $r$, does $f(X)=\sum_{p\le X}\log(N_p/p)$ grow asymptotically like $r\log\log X$?

records.name: Coordinates on convex domains
records.statement: For a compact convex domain $\Omega$, the values of $F_\Omega$ at the vertices of its corner locus $C_\Omega$ give complete coordinates. How are these coordinates for $\Omega$ related to those for the dual domain $\Omega^*$?

records.name: Higher-dimensional cropping formula
records.statement: Find a higher-dimensional analogue of the paper's cropping and summation argument; in dimension three the expected sum ranges over quadruples $v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4$ for which $\operatorname{ConvHull}(0,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)$ contains no lattice points.

records.name: Complex continuation of the associated zeta function
records.statement: For $Z(s)=\sum f(a,b,c,d)^s$, which is known to converge for real $s>1/2$, extend $Z$ to complex values of $s$.

records.name: Alternative and arithmetic proofs of the pi identities
records.statement: Give another proof of the paper's identities (Ж) and (ж) using the methods for identity (1). Can $f(a,b,c,d)$ be interpreted as a residue at $(a+b)+(c+d)i$, or otherwise related to the Gaussian integers?

records.name: Modular extension and analogous lattice series
records.statement: Can the function $f$ on $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ be extended naturally to $\mathbb{C}/SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$? Can analogous series be constructed for other lattices or tessellations of the plane?

records.name: Odd-prime-power periodicity conjecture
records.statement: For every odd prime $p$ and $k\ge1$, is $s(p^k)=k$? For $k\ge2$, is $d(p^k)=p^{k-1}d(p)$?

records.name: Power-of-two periodicity conjecture
records.statement: For every $k\ge1$, is $s(2^k)=u_k$? Is $d(2^k)=2^k$ for $k\ne2$, with $d(4)=2$?

records.name: Arnold sequence as an f-transform
records.statement: Is Arnold's sequence $(u_k)_{k\ge1}$ the $f$-transform of the quadruple $(2,4,4,4)$?

records.name: Existence of a four-dimensional Euler brick
records.statement: Do there exist positive integers $a,b,c,d$ such that all six pairwise face diagonals $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$, $\sqrt{a^2+c^2}$, $\sqrt{a^2+d^2}$, $\sqrt{b^2+c^2}$, $\sqrt{b^2+d^2}$, and $\sqrt{c^2+d^2}$ are integers?

records.name: Computational Diffie–Hellman problem
records.statement: Given a prime modulus $p$, a group generator $g$, and the public values $g^a$ and $g^b$ modulo $p$, can the shared value $g^{ab}\bmod p$ be computed efficiently without knowing $a$ or $b$?

records.name: A seventeenth-century proof of Fermat's Last Theorem
records.statement: Can Fermat's Last Theorem be proved using only mathematical techniques that were available in the seventeenth century?

records.name: Rational distances from the vertices of a square
records.statement: Given a unit square, does there exist a point in its plane, inside or outside the square, whose distances from all four vertices are rational? Equivalently after scaling, can a square $ABCD$ and a coplanar point $P$ be found such that $AB,PA,PB,PC,PD$ are all integers?

records.name: Semi-magic square of distinct positive cubes
records.statement: Does there exist a $3\times3$ semi-magic square whose nine entries are distinct positive integer cubes and whose three row sums and three column sums are all equal?

records.name: Büchi's problem

records.statement: Catalan–Dickson conjecture on aliquot sequences: no aliquot sequences are infinite but non-repeating.

records.statement: Exponent pair conjecture: for all $\varepsilon > 0$, is the pair $(\varepsilon, 1/2 + \varepsilon)$ an exponent pair?

Must $\rho$, up to the standard finite-image and Tate-twist qualifications, arise from the étale cohomology of an algebraic variety over $K$?

records.name: Local Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
records.statement: For the classical-group pairs and generic local $L$-parameters in the Gan–Gross–Prasad setting, is there exactly one relevant representation $\pi$ in the associated $L$-packet for which $\operatorname{Hom}_H(\pi\otimes\overline\nu,\mathbb C)$ is nonzero, namely the representation indexed by the distinguished Gan–Gross–Prasad character?

records.name: Greenberg's Iwasawa-invariants conjecture
records.statement: For every totally real number field $F$ and prime $p$, do the Iwasawa invariants $\lambda(F_\infty/F)$ and $\mu(F_\infty/F)$ of the cyclotomic $\mathbb Z_p$-extension both vanish; equivalently, is the $p$-part of the class numbers in the tower bounded?

records.name: Hermite's problem
records.statement: Hermite's problem: is it possible, for any natural number $n$, to assign a sequence of natural numbers to each real number such that the sequence for $x$ is eventually periodic if and only if $x$ is algebraic of degree $n$?

records.name: Kummer–Vandiver conjecture
records.statement: Kummer–Vandiver conjecture: primes $p$ do not divide the class number of the maximal real subfield of the $p$-th cyclotomic field.

records.name: Lang and Trotter's conjecture
records.statement: Lang and Trotter's conjecture on supersingular primes that the number of supersingular primes less than a constant $X$ is within a constant multiple of $\sqrt{X}/\ln{X}$

records.name: Stark conjectures on leading terms of Artin L-functions

records.name: Characterize all algebraic number fields that have some power basis

records.name: Beilinson conjectures on special values of motivic L-functions
records.statement: For a motive (or the cohomology of a smooth projective variety) and an appropriate integer argument, is the order of vanishing of its L-function the predicted motivic-cohomology rank, and is its first nonzero Taylor coefficient, up to the prescribed rational factor, the determinant of the Beilinson regulator?

records.name: First Hardy–Littlewood zeta-function conjecture

records.name: Keating–Snaith moment conjecture for the Riemann zeta function

records.name: Selberg's orthogonality conjecture

records.name: Bombieri–Lang conjecture

records.name: Manin conjecture

records.name: Generalized Sato–Tate conjecture
records.statement: For an abelian variety or suitable motive over a number field, are its normalized Frobenius conjugacy classes equidistributed in the associated compact Sato–Tate group with respect to Haar measure?

records.name: Vojta's conjecture

records.name: The n-conjecture
records.statement: Fix $n\geq3$. If coprime nonzero integers $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ have sum zero and no proper subsum zero, is it true that for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is $C_{n,\varepsilon}$ such that $\max_i|a_i|<C_{n,\varepsilon}\operatorname{rad}(|a_1\cdots a_n|)^{2n-5+\varepsilon}$?

records.name: Szpiro's conjecture
records.statement: Szpiro's conjecture: for any $\varepsilon > 0$, there is some constant $C(\varepsilon)$ such that, for any elliptic curve $E$ defined over $\mathbb{Q}$ with minimal discriminant $\Delta$ and conductor $f$, we have $|\Delta| \leq C(\varepsilon) \cdot f^{6+\varepsilon}$.

records.name: Zilber–Pink conjecture
records.statement: Zilber–Pink conjecture that if $X$ is a mixed Shimura variety or semiabelian variety defined over $\mathbb{C}$, and $V \subseteq X$ is a subvariety, then $V$ contains only finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties.
